body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I just walked off the stage after debating Brian Kemp and presenting my
plan for Georgia’s future for the last time in this campaign. Right now,
we have a clear choice in this election: we can choose someone who is for
the people and will defend our freedom, or someone who is for himself and
will attack our rights.

I hope I made you — my team of grassroots supporters who have had my back
every step of the way — proud on that stage tonight.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221030_B5_PostDebate_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=16175%2E1862389%2EVhIUfB ]Now, I need your help to win this race and build a Georgia where
everyone can thrive — not just survive. Can I count on your support to
make my vision a reality? If you’re with me in this fight all the way,
make your first
donation to my campaign right now:

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221030_B5_PostDebate_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=16175%2E1862389%2EVhIUfB ]DONATE

Tonight’s debate was about what the next four years will look like for
Georgia. And the best way to understand what is to come under an Abrams
Administration is to look at my record.

I fought to defend our democracy against policies that blocked voters from
being heard. I helped to pay off the medical debt of 68,000 Georgians. My
organization installed WiFi units across Georgia to ensure communities
stayed connected when the state lagged behind on broadband access.

Whether I have had a title or not, I have always fought for the people of
Georgia. I did that as a state legislator, as a small business owner and
as a proud Georgian.

Time and again, I have shown up for Georgians when our current governor
wouldn’t. And in the next four years, as governor, I will do it again.
From expanding Medicaid to legalizing gaming in order to pour more money
into our kids’ futures, I will take action.

I am the only candidate with a real plan to not just lift up some, but to
build One Georgia for us all. That is why it’s time to fire Brian Kemp and
hire me as the next governor of Georgia.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221030_B5_PostDebate_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=16175%2E1862389%2EVhIUfB ]But I need your help to get there. Derek,
can you please chip in now to seize this
moment, undo all the harm Brian Kemp has done to our state and build One
Georgia, where everyone has the opportunity to thrive? We don’t have much
time left in this campaign, so please, don’t wait. Can you make your
first donation
tonight?

Thank you,

Stacey Abrams

I hope I made you — my team of grassroots supporters who have had my back every step of the way — proud on that stage tonight. Hey, I wanted to reach out to you personally.

We can’t make the mistake of standing by while a celebrity scam doctor buys his way into the U.S. Senate.
#
Derek,
When John stepped onto that debate stage last week, he made it clear that he’s the _only_ candidate willing to fight for real people all across PA.
That's why Dr. Oz + his allies are spending million$ on attack ads and avoiding any questions about where Oz stands on the issues Pennsylvanians actually care about.
We have to fight back with everything we’ve got to make sure John’s message and vision can break through before all the votes are counted.
**[Tomorrow at midnight is our _last end-of-month fundraising deadline_ before Election Day. Will you rush $5 or whatever you can so we can keep up the momentum and defeat Dr. Oz on November 8?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221030-4?refcode=em20221030-7970&refcode2=7970_434096_y7-mR0&akid=7970%2E434096%2Ey7-mR0)**

We had a nice chat about memories over these last 23 years together – including standing on stage together the night I became America’s first Latina senator. I remembered something important in talking about memories with my husband tonight: First, I’ve been fortunate to have Paul by my side during two challenging, battleground races for U.S. Senate. But I’ve been doubly fortunate because I also have you and this amazing grassroots team fighting hard alongside me.

So, I trust I can be upfront with you: I’m in the political fight of my life and our country’s future is at stake. After the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. November. Just check out these pics from the road:

pitch in $20 or more to power Charles Booker’s bus tour across Kentucky in
the final days of this election?

Unlike Rand Paul, Charles knows what it’s like to sacrifice and struggle
to make ends meet. And he’s running for Senate to help other Kentuckians
just like him.

We can do this -- but we need your help!

Thanks for your support,

Team Booker HQ

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Fellow American,

Friday night former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a62fb723bea24becae957d44f95dd8c2&_e=OzbDtQ4LrwEjTKMzpg1GMrUKccx0t5G5IFCEWwWGY64ZyZ5JlbBE1TJh_2kRURnajuyn39XaFA9OZWZx210hvXzgvFyIl5mx8cG_hdv6gHvHa57bpVCLZeffwQA3ayhbjzOpy_p1a871xC40zky-5W2fE8QMO6Zk9Zv5e9sfU2v_ZKjz2YzsKiYOG6ZHNSmJKUiAoO7v7yTta-vd9d4iFfqd5YbIdHdqTZJ-Ng7NPVdEPcjBpR5Mxie7CXZBTdSvw52Yf9W09Jq4MVQNW7eaUGfTHyYito-0AhmKuG0klOms5EwMTkJ-bwQKrM8hRvYaFMYDp1foa-U_UZbAUKiSUy05FxMOznZHuIRzdAjLXrkTo_5c8iAP-O29dC8UyJHqDceUOeV2ba9dhQxGF3BNgWpYARiHZn9UP_-nv-eT9K0%3D)
Democrats know that Georgia is KEY to the Senate majority, so they are using all their big names to make a last-minute pitch for the struggling campaigns of Warnock and Abrams.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a62fb723bea24becae957d44f95dd8c2&_e=OzbDtQ4LrwEjTKMzpg1GMrUKccx0t5G5IFCEWwWGY64ZyZ5JlbBE1TJh_2kRURnajuyn39XaFA9OZWZx210hvXzgvFyIl5mx8cG_hdv6gHvHa57bpVCLZeffwQA3ayhbjzOpy_p1a871xC40zky-5W2fE8QMO6Zk9Zv5e9sfU2v_ZKjz2YzsKiYOG6ZHNSmJKUiAoO7v7yTta-vd9d4iFfqd5YbIdHdqTZJ-Ng7NPVdEPcjBpR5Mxie7CXZBTdSvLN7bA8F0WfjWLS331mAl8x4mTS-nfuUi2sbbsRfKPX2Z40lWhq929dDOTagDyqSIQEkqyNJx-wrUqGKsP8pyVaJKIoVXTWKd3L-lF7GlnkkiXqQz2SIaVAyOGIFjEoaDXYt_gDFr_enNY4VbuurTT40rY6reIlf98qBDSp3ud5A%3D)
They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. subject: Push to the Finish!
body:
Been quite a Journey | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| Aloha!
We can see the Finish Line now. It's been a long but incredibly rewarding experience interacting with a wide range of people, groups, businesses, labor unions, churches, community organizations and neighborhood boards. As long as it has been, it's also been too short!!!

It's been fantastic to see the groundswell of "ordinary" people stepping up with their time and energy to try and effect the necessary, Positive Change in Hawai'i.

No matter the outcome, the conversations were had and voices were heard.

Best to everyone!

Mahalos!!!

Conrad Kress
Running for US Congress, Hawai'i, District 1
---
|
---
|
---
| Kailua resident and former Navy SEAL Conrad Kress is the Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives seat covering urban and suburban Oʻahu from Hawaii Kai to Ko Olina. He faces incumbent U.S. Rep. Ed Case, a Democrat. The Conversation spoke to Kress about his background and some of the issues he’ll be tasked with addressing if elected. Our interview with Democratic candidate U.S. Rep. Ed Case aired on Thursday, Oct. 27.

On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them.

| Peter,
It's Tulsi Gabbard, former Democratic Congresswoman and former Vice Chair of the Democratic National Committee.
I recently left the Democratic Party because it's under the complete control of an elitist cabal of warmongers driven by cowardly "wokeness." | | | | [DEFEAT WOKENESS](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61764950:6_b8eQGRN:m:1:3331703221:CC12C12EC4F43C7926B70D14961041C3:r)
---
Democrats have gone insane with ideological fanaticism, and to put it plainly, the Democratic Party that I joined doesn't exist anymore.

**[Today, I'm proud to endorse John Gibbs for Congress in Michigan's 3rd District.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61764950:6_b8eQGRN:m:1:3331703221:CC12C12EC4F43C7926B70D14961041C3:r)** John is a leader who puts people first, is fighting for border security, energy independence, public safety, and other policies that actually make life better for the American people.

My parents were married in East Grand Rapids, which is my mother's hometown. This district and John's race matter to me. **[So I hope you'll join me today in supporting John's campaign with a generous gift.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61764950:6_b8eQGRN:m:1:3331703221:CC12C12EC4F43C7926B70D14961041C3:r)**

John isn't afraid to call out permanent Washington and the propagandists in the mainstream media who aim to keep them in power.

Our country is in desperate need of leaders like John who will stand up for the objective truth and bring the fight directly to the dogmatic fanaticism of ideologues leading the Democratic Party.

**[Please join me in supporting John's campaign here.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61764950:6_b8eQGRN:m:1:3331703221:CC12C12EC4F43C7926B70D14961041C3:r)**

With aloha,

Tulsi Gabbard

| Peter, This is Glenn Youngkin, Governor of Virginia - I'm glad to reach you today. **The urgent drive to Election Day 2022 is officially underway.** The red wave started last November when we beat the national Democrat machine and defied expectations in the Old Dominion. Now, the Republican Governors Association has an aggressive campaign plan to **KEEP THE MOMENTUM GOING AND BRING THE RED WAVE ACROSS AMERICA this November.**

The nation saw Virginians come together behind common-sense solutions to kitchen table issues and win last year.

Now national Democrats are determined to prevent it from happening again, using my victory as a warning to energize their base and raise support.

[**We can't let them outwork us - and it's vital that we have the resources to WIN!**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61025543:saPDP5hN5:m:1:2202880964:A20C19102059C260162F8B641C4934E4:r)

---
**CONFIDENTIAL REPUBLICAN GOVERNORS MEMO** ATTN: Top Republican Supporters
RE: 2022 Victory Resources

_Overview & Game Plan_: We have two weeks to go until Election Day 2022 with 36 governorships on the ballot - we have _strong momentum_ to hold the line and gain ground, but it's vital that we raise additional resources quickly. Recent polls show the Democrats gaining ground in top battlegrounds that we're fighting to protect, including Florida, Georgia, and Texas. At the same time, we have a lot of hard work ahead of us to flip Democrat-held governorships in states like Kansas, Michigan, Nevada, and Wisconsin.

_Ramping Up Our Ground Game_ : Our fast-growing grassroots teams in battleground states are hard at work, and it's vital that we have the resources to sustain their efforts. _We're asking every Republican supporter to make a special contribution to ensure the Democrats don't gain an edge on the ground._

_Resources Needed_ : We need every dollar we can raise to purchase water and meals for our volunteers, to fill their gas tanks as they travel far and wide to canvass door-to-door, keep our radio and TV ads running, and send text messages to voters.

_Bottom Line_ : We want you to help elect Republican Governors who will implement winning solutions to our nation's most important issues - quality education for all; lower taxes for affordable living; greater security and safety for all and individual freedoms.

Thank you for taking time out to read this memo today.

**Please rush your most generous possible contribution NOW.**

Happy Halloween everyone! I hope you all are having fun this year dressing up, eating candy and watching plenty of scary movies! My favorite Halloween tradition is going to haunted houses, but this year there’s only one haunted house that’s really been scaring me... the House of Representatives if we let Republicans take control! Jim Jordan and his ghoulish friends in DC are planning to BAN abortion nationwide, try to impeach Biden, and end social security and Medicare. We HAVE to stop them if we want to protect our rights, lower inflation, and fix our country!
I am running to take the mask off the monster, and expose Jim Jordan for who he really is: a lying, cheating, corrupt career politician who doesn’t care about people. He turned a blind eye to Dr. Strauss’s sexual abuse at OSU, he let an armed mob STORM our Capitol and savagely attack police officers, and now he’s IGNORING his district to spend millions on his campaign to become speaker! Oh, and did I mention he's trying to control your healthcare decisions for you? He wants to force his way into our doctors’ offices (a la Shining, see picture below) and tell us what we can and can’t do with OUR own bodies. YIKES, what a creep!
But don’t worry, just like in the movies, this bad guy is gonna get what’s coming to him. We are just EIGHT days away from shocking the world, unseating Jim Jordan, and bringing real working class interests back to Washington. These next eight days are absolutely CRUCIAL and I could really use your help while we make our final push to win this election. Can you chip in $25, $50, $100, $500, $1,000, or even $2,900 to make sure we get rid of the ghoul that’s been haunting our district?
Thanks and Happy Halloween,
Tamie

| Peter,

**I left the Democratic Party because they 've become obsessed with pushing a woke agenda**.

Now, I'm doing all that I can to help Republican Senator Mike Lee win in November so he can return to Washington and defend our freedom.

**We need your help.**

I know Mike, and I worked with him when I was in Congress. I know him to be a man of principle, faith, and patriotism. [**That 's why I am supporting him in this race, and why I'm asking you to rush your own support to his campaign right away - we have just a few days before the election.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61765763:6K2q5QGNn:m:1:3371220873:E11CB761163BF5624A12262C288D74A8:r)

As a combat veteran and former member of Congress, I took an oath to defend our Constitution, and it's something I take very seriously.

I refuse to be a part of today's Democratic Party that is controlled by fanatical ideologues who hate freedom and work to silence and destroy anyone who opposes their efforts to undermine it. And I certainly won't be sidelined as these same elites in Washington use their majorities in Congress to unleash their radical agenda on the rest of us.

If you can't stomach the direction that so-called woke Democrats in Washington are taking our country, join me and go all in to support Mike Lee's re-election. body:
|
| | | Peter,

Hi, I'm former Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard - please take a moment to read this entire message. It's critical to the future of our country.

Recently, I announced that I am leaving the Democratic Party, and I want to take a moment to tell you why.

I believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. Unfortunately, today's Democratic Party does not. Instead, it stands for a government of, by, and for the powerful elite.

I love our country. Our God-given rights of freedom, life, and liberty enshrined in our Constitution and Bill of Rights are my inspiration. I answered the call to serve and took an oath, dedicating my life to supporting and defending those freedoms, both in uniform and in public office.

**[Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That's why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61765879:6mUVUQGNi:m:1:3374627611:13E7CC31D6A6644F5356D3DE3FDD2FB2:r "Now, my mission
continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin. ")**

He just told me he is coming up on his biggest fundraising deadline and is still $4,457 short of his goal. **[Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61765879:6mUVUQGNi:m:1:3374627611:13E7CC31D6A6644F5356D3DE3FDD2FB2:r "Can you chip in
$10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?")**

Your donation will send a strong message to Democratic Party elites that we are tired of their constant attacks on our freedoms.

Let's remember the ideals our founders laid out for us. Draw inspiration from their hopes for this country, and take action to bring about a government that is truly of, by, and for the people.

If you can't stomach the direction that so-called woke Democratic Party ideologues are taking our country, I invite you to join me.

**[A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61765879:6mUVUQGNi:m:1:3374627611:13E7CC31D6A6644F5356D3DE3FDD2FB2:r "A donation of

Tulsi Gabbard

body:
|
| | | Peter,

Hi, I'm former Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard - please take a moment to read this entire message. It's critical to the future of our country.

Recently, I announced that I am leaving the Democratic Party, and I want to take a moment to tell you why.

I believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. Unfortunately, today's Democratic Party does not. Instead, it stands for a government of, by, and for the powerful elite.

I love our country. Our God-given rights of freedom, life, and liberty enshrined in our Constitution and Bill of Rights are my inspiration. I answered the call to serve and took an oath, dedicating my life to supporting and defending those freedoms, both in uniform and in public office.

**[Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That's why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61766053:6AIg0QGfN:m:1:3253819041:4BCE2F23A4C0AB6405F5FBB1659C0DE3:r "Now, my mission
continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin. ")**

He just told me he is coming up on his biggest fundraising deadline and is still $4,457 short of his goal. **[Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61766053:6AIg0QGfN:m:1:3253819041:4BCE2F23A4C0AB6405F5FBB1659C0DE3:r "Can you chip in
$10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?")**

Your donation will send a strong message to Democratic Party elites that we are tired of their constant attacks on our freedoms.

Let's remember the ideals our founders laid out for us. Draw inspiration from their hopes for this country, and take action to bring about a government that is truly of, by, and for the people.

If you can't stomach the direction that so-called woke Democratic Party ideologues are taking our country, I invite you to join me.

**[A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61766053:6AIg0QGfN:m:1:3253819041:4BCE2F23A4C0AB6405F5FBB1659C0DE3:r "A donation of $10,
$25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders. ")**

Tulsi Gabbard

We’re almost at the finish line.

Everything is on the line – reproductive rights, the future of bipartisanship, American democracy, and more. Josh’s far-right extremist opponent, Frank Pallotta has made it abundantly clear that he will not hesitate to undo all of Josh’s progress.

Josh isn’t finished yet, and neither are we. Here at Gottheimer HQ, our team is working around the clock to manage our phone banks, text banks, letter drives, and other voter outreach initiatives. We’re doing everything we can to get the word out about Josh – but, this is only made possible through your support.

Josh is working hard every day in Congress to defend Jersey Values, let’s have his back in these critical final days ahead of November 8.

| | At Miami’s Dade-Collier Training and Transition Airport last week, 29-year-old Rubén Martínez emerged from the [Soviet-era 1940s biplane](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._VUxhs7edBrqg) he had just flown from Cuba. His [defection](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._7wzx7W61MZFn8Oe3Qbbw) brings attention to widespread demonstrations against the communist nation that have been taking place since [July 2021](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ2MDA3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/aqgjJQAxNCA_uVUTPfxJ2g). Against a backdrop of government-caused shortages of food, fuel and medicine recently exacerbated by Hurricane Ian, brave protesters shouted for _libertad_ (freedom). Nearly 500 demonstrators have been convicted of sedition, with some receiving sentences as long as [30 years](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ2MDA3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/5_UO-WAYto3O-4Bozfz3DQ). Martínez’ flight for freedom serves as a reminder to Americans of the dangers of socialism and one-party rule. “Freedom is a fragile thing and it's never more than one generation away from extinction,” Ronald Reagan [said](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ2MDA3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/Ag3nato0k2uF9zSmjSeEzA). “It is not ours by way of inheritance; it must be fought for and defended constantly by each generation, for it comes only once to a people.” In this midterm election – in which nothing short of our _Libertad_ is on the line – more than just showing up to vote is required of patriots. How will you defend this generation’s freedom?
---
| | [](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._UIL4QhIxyFs9g)

Text messaging voters is one of the easiest and simplest Get Out The Vote activities available! We are running out of time to influence voters and remind them to vote, so please sign up to help today! Please go to [**tpp.me/textvoters**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) to sign up. You will be asked for your cell phone number, your name, and your email address. Then just click on the button that says “Start Texting!” You’ll then receive a text message on your cell phone that includes a link for you to get started. That link will take you to the instructions, and you can start immediately!

body:

---
Peter,

Last week former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61768705:J9QjjsG2N:m:1:3331703221:F6E5AA44F08339AB836B5978FB90854B:r)
Democrats know that Georgia is KEY to the Senate majority, so they are using all their big names to make a last-minute pitch for the struggling campaigns of Warnock and Abrams.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61768705:J9QjjsG2N:m:1:3331703221:F6E5AA44F08339AB836B5978FB90854B:r)
They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. And we know they're desperate because we heard it directly from Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden this week during their hot mic moment. **That's why Democrats sounded the alarm and asked President Obama to campaign in Georgia.**

_**What did President Obama have to say about me?**_ He called me a celebrity who wants to be a politician. He got that one wrong. I'm not a celebrity or your typical politician; _I'm a warrior for God._

He got something else wrong, too. He encouraged us to vote for Joe Biden two years ago, didn't he? We've all seen how that's worked out for us - record inflation, open borders, more crime, and less freedom.

**With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out.**

But here's the thing, Peter. President Obama's visit to Georgia will gin up Democrats and help Senator Warnock raise millions. The moment he got off the stage, my opponent was begging supporters for money.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61768705:J9QjjsG2N:m:1:3331703221:F6E5AA44F08339AB836B5978FB90854B:r)
**[I need your help. We're being outraised by millions, and the gap is growing with President Obama's visit. Will you chip in $5, $10, or even $34 today?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61768705:J9QjjsG2N:m:1:3331703221:F6E5AA44F08339AB836B5978FB90854B:r)**

Thanks for standing with me in these final days.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61768705:J9QjjsG2N:m:1:3331703221:F6E5AA44F08339AB836B5978FB90854B:r)

Herschel Walker

| Hi ,

As one of our most loyal supporters, [can you do me a favor and forward this message to someone you know?](http://us14.forward-to-friend.com/forward?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=57b182da2f&e=f9133ea432)

This is the truth:

Gavin Newsom has made it all but impossible to afford life in California.

Here's what we have to show for his failed governorship:
* Gas prices have nearly doubled.
* Food has become extremely expensive due to the over-regulation of our supply chain.
* Utilities have skyrocketed because of a mismanaged power grid.
* Rent and home purchases have become too expensive because of ‘red tape’ on new construction.

Who can possibly afford 4 more years of Newsom?

These days, middle-class citizens are having to decide between filling their gas tank or putting food on the table.

This has to stop.

California CAN be affordable - we simply have to change the progressive policies that are driving people out.

As your new Governor...

I will lower the cost of gas.

I will lower the cost of food.

I will lower the cost of housing.

I will lower the cost of your energy bills.

Bottom line: I want you to be able to afford to live in California.

That’s why one more time - I’m asking you to help us cross the finish line.

We can’t lower the cost of living in California if we don’t rally Californians to vote on November 8th.

Peter,

Election Day is just 8 days away, and the stakes have never been higher.

My opponent is a liberal puppet for the Biden Regime. His only goal is turning our state into a wasteland where the government can deprive us of our rights and lock us down at any time.

Charlie voted 100% of the time with Joe Biden in Washington, D.C., and now he’s hoping to make our state an extension of the failed Biden administration.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=57e6a7fc51e23a9bd8276f1c9a979f1038ea7aa563f8a2b8af3345f1c146ef79b5051f31a2defdccc211611137e3ba70c246fcd098b2eb4b
STOP THE BIDEN-CRIST AGENDA

We don’t have to guess what Democrat control of Florida would mean, Peter — we see the consequences every day in states like California and New York:

▪️ Crime so rampant citizens don’t even feel safe in their own homes.

▪️ Power-hungry politicians so fixated on authoritarian rule they’ll stop at nothing until they control every aspect of your life.

▪️ Radicalized teachers’ unions with free rein to inject woke ideologies like CRT and gender theories into your child’s classroom.

I’ve protected our state from suffering the same fate as woke blue states, but the far-Left is working overtime to take control of Florida and impose the destructive Biden-Crist agenda on us.

The Left knows I am the last line of defense against their extreme ideology, so they are sending in the cavalry hoping to help my opponent make a comeback.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=57e6a7fc51e23a9bd8276f1c9a979f1038ea7aa563f8a2b8af3345f1c146ef79b5051f31a2defdccc211611137e3ba70c246fcd098b2eb4b
RUSH IN YOUR IMMEDIATE SUPPORT BEFORE OUR LAST DEADLINE

Right now, out-of-touch elitists and D.C. Democrats are pouring money into my opponent’s campaign account in the 11th hour. They have MILLIONS at their disposal, and they’re ready to unleash their war chest to see Florida fall to their extremism.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=57e6a7fc51e23a9bd8276f1c9a979f1038ea7aa563f8a2b8af3345f1c146ef79b5051f31a2defdccc211611137e3ba70c246fcd098b2eb4b
>>>">Send in your immediate support to help us meet our critical deadline. >>>

We cannot allow that to happen, Peter, but it’s going to take all hands on deck to protect our state from the Left’s destructive schemes.

I need your immediate support in the final stretch of this campaign to ensure we Keep Florida Free.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=57e6a7fc51e23a9bd8276f1c9a979f1038ea7aa563f8a2b8af3345f1c146ef79b5051f31a2defdccc211611137e3ba70c246fcd098b2eb4b
>>>">Chip in NOW to help us reach our FINAL end-of-month fundraising goal of the campaign. >>>

There’s too much at stake to sit on the sidelines.

We don’t have a moment to spare as the Left continues to inflate my opponent’s campaign account with their dark money donations.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=57e6a7fc51e23a9bd8276f1c9a979f1038ea7aa563f8a2b8af3345f1c146ef79b5051f31a2defdccc211611137e3ba70c246fcd098b2eb4b
RUSH IN A DONATION

Unlike my opponent who relies on the liberal media to campaign for him, I am counting on the support of everyday supporters to help take me across the finish line of this race.

I cannot do this without your help, Peter.

Can I count on you to join me in the fight to keep the far-Left’s extreme agenda out of our state?
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=57e6a7fc51e23a9bd8276f1c9a979f1038ea7aa563f8a2b8af3345f1c146ef79b5051f31a2defdccc211611137e3ba70c246fcd098b2eb4b
>>">Pitch in NOW before our FINAL deadline. >>>

Thank you for your support,
Ron DeSantis

name: Chrissy
subject: we need ALL hands on deck in this final stretch, Derek
body:
We are only 8 days away from the election, and we are all hands on deck here at HoulaHQ.
| | |
---
Derek, happy Halloween! I genuinely love this holiday. (A little more during off years.)

**We are only 8 days away from the election, and we are all hands on deck here at HoulaHQ.**
We've ramped up our efforts by knocking on every door, coordinating up and down the ticket, making phone calls to everybody who has requested a ballot, and recently, launching two AWESOME ads – "Dreams" and "One Chip At A Time" – to spread our message to voters all over PA-06. In these ads, I discuss my path to Congress, the work I've done since I started serving, and what I’ll do with the opportunity to continue serving. This includes voting for the Inflation Reduction Act, protecting the right to choose, defending democracy, lowering costs for working families, and creating thousands of jobs in our district.
But while I'm fighting for working families, our opponent would try to take us backward on each of these issues. Worse, GOP super PACs, Kevin McCarthy, and RNC Chair Ronna McDaniel (who has continued to dabble with Trump’s "Big Lie") have rallied behind him, pouring thousands into his campaign so they can run misleading ads against our progress.

**The truth is, if Republicans retake the House majority, they’re prepared to end Social Security and pass a nationwide abortion ban. That's why holding the House is so important – and it's also why I'm asking you to donate today.**
From abortion rights to voting rights, climate change to education, too much is on the line for us to lose this seat. And right now, we have $6,384 left to raise in order to reach our October goal.

**Derek, I need your help to close the gap. Please pitch in $5 – or whatever you can – by midnight so that we can hit our October goal and make sure we have the resources to defend this battleground seat. You can donate here: **[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53719014/376274693/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk731-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDAyN2FiMy0yYzU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tctWYBYkaNtV3dyXpmGpptJHMBi_gEsMDMiJyIMq7qk=)
I'm so excited to continue building on the progress we've made for PA-06, but first I need your help to get reelected this November. I simply can't do it without your support.

Thank you, Derek. There's work to be done. But first, please be sure to enjoy some candy. 🍭 🍬

body:
I was born in a time when abortions were illegal. But no one has been born in a time when abortions didn't happen.
| | |
---
Peter – I was born in a time when abortions were illegal. **But no one has been born in a time when abortions didn't _happen_.**
Before Roe v. Wade, women were forced to seek the care they needed not in an exam room, but through dangerous, unregulated procedures or self-administered efforts, often in moments of desperation. **As a nurse and a mother, I understand more than most that abortion can be genuinely lifesaving – but in the world I grew up in, it could also be deadly.**
That's why Roe v. Wade was so transformative. It gave us all the freedom to safely and independently make choices about our futures, our bodies, and our health without interference or mandated bans from political leaders. **But now the dangerous, radical decision by this Supreme Court to overturn Roe v. Wade has s****et our country back decades.**
**And in the wake of this ruling, my opponent Eric Schmitt made Missouri the first state to enact a so-called "trigger ban."** Under this law, performing an abortion at ANY stage of pregnancy is a felony – and this is only just the start.
I refuse to sit idly by as I watch my state and my country go backward. That's why I'm working my heart out to defeat Eric Schmitt and stop him from taking his far-right ideology to the U.S. Senate. **You have my word on this: If you send me to Washington, I will proudly be _the_ vote that we need to codify abortion access into law once and for all.**
**[We're in the fight of our lives here, Peter. If you're willing to work with me, will you make a $5 donation to help me flip Missouri blue and ensure that future generations have the freedom to choose? Team —
I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.
No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.
And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.
National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. But I refuse to let them win.
I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — will you split a donation between my campaign and Seth Moulton if you agree? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221031_MK_split]
I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — if you agree, will you split a donation between my campaign and Seth Moulton? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221031_MK_split]
Science, data, and facts have helped me solve some of the most difficult challenges in my life. And I think we need more members of Congress who are willing to put politics aside and do the same.
I can’t overstate how important this upcoming election is. Chip in $20 or more today, split between my campaign and Seth Moulton, if you’re ready to help me win re-election and defend our majority >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221031_MK_split]
I’ll never back down from doing what’s right.
Thank you for staying in the fight with me,
Mark

Friends, For months, radical Stacey Abrams has tried to refute her early support of the "Defund The Police" [movement](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3610623.632.1.3677d8a4a8859e72ebcedf922720799f). She even [proposed pay raises](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3610623.633.1.88a7291395beaa92904b8cc4cec22083) for our men and women in uniform to showcase her support of law enforcement. But last night during the [final gubernatorial debate](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3610623.634.1.0d1edd590a4a01d7cf55e29f020daed0), she let her true colors show. In response to 107 Georgia Sheriffs backing Governor Kemp's re-election campaign, here's what Abrams had to say: _"I'm not a member of the good ol' boys club. So, no. I don't have 107 sheriffs who want to be able to take Black people off the streets, who want to be able to go without accountability."_ In a fit of desperation, Stacey Abrams, who continues to slip in the polls, accused a majority of the Sheriffs in Georgia of being racist, reckless, and unaccountable. WOW! Clearly, Abrams is no friend of the law enforcement community and would undermine public safety if elected as Georgia's next Governor. With Election Day next week and record Early Voting numbers across Georgia, we have to do everything we can to #StopStacey once and for all. Can you donate [$50 right now](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3610623.635.1.1d2a3a331ae01b7e4668b56cabbc1d41) to help sustain our efforts? We are fighting everyday to expose Abrams, her network, and the radical agenda she wants to force down our throats. [Chip in NOW](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=3610623.636.1.05a96e4302f1ecaf6d8b8a6aa5f2f216) and let's sound the alarm that Abrams thinks law enforcement leaders are racists and backs a plan that will make our neighborhoods less safe. Thank you in advance for your support. Together, we will Stop Stacey and Save America! For Freedom, Stop Stacey Digital Team

subject: I’m saving the fundraising for the end. This discussion needs to happen first.

body:
It's the last day of the month – our last big fundraising deadline before Election Day – and we are counting on grassroots supporters like you to power us across the line. According to convention, that means I should ask you to chip in right here, at the top of the email.

Instead, I'd like to save the fundraising ask for the end of this note. First, I want to talk a little about our campaign's values, and the way that thousands of people's voices could be drowned out by one wealthy family.

Big money in politics isn't a new problem – our movement has been talking about the dangers since way before this election. Still, it's worth noting that our race this year offers a case study in how unrestricted spending threatens our democracy.

I've always looked at elections not as a chance to take power or to win at all costs, but as a chance to serve . That's why I've always built campaigns around listening, asking questions, responding to needs, and looking for ways to make life better for people in New Jersey. And by focusing on people, we have created an amazing movement made up of thousands (including you) who believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people.

My opponent, Bob Healey, has barely made an effort to connect with folks in our district. And because he has no experience in public service or in the workforce, he doesn't have any accomplishments to talk about.

But what he does have is money – lots of it – that he inherited from his family's business selling luxury yachts to the super-wealthy.

In addition to the $2 million his mom has dumped into a super PAC to attack me, Healey is giving his own campaign millions more. So far, he's spent $2.7 million of that inheritance to buy himself time on television to distort my record and lie about the work I've done to keep people safe, lower costs, and support our veterans. He gave himself $1.5 million of that money in just the last three weeks.

Some perspective: in those same three weeks, our campaign raised about 1/5 that much, but from hundreds of people.

And there's the problem: one wealthy heir's whim can overpower the voices of hundreds of working families.

The only movement Bob Healey has created is the movement of his pen across his checkbook – but that's been enough to buy publicity and airtime. He's spent most of that time distorting my Congressional record and parroting dangerous right-wing talking points. And while he amplifies that dishonest nonsense, he also conveniently leaves out that his values are way out of line with our district:

*He wants to cut taxes on ultra-luxury purchases (for example, the yachts that he profits from);

*He sneers at tax cuts and cost savings for working people;

* He wants to take away New Jersey women's right to reproductive health care, which he frames as a "compromise."

These are extreme, and extremely dangerous positions, which is why most people in our district don't support them or him. Bob Healey is spending millions to try to shift the conversation, and unfortunately, it could work. This race is coming down to the wire.

We've pinched our pennies, we've done our homework, and we have a plan that can win. Together, we can counter his massive spending with grassroots support, and make sure the truth wins during this final week. Can you donate $12 today to show the strength of this movement? subject: I hate asking this of you...
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
One of the hardest parts of this job is asking for money.

Derek — I know we’re getting down to the wire here and you probably have a lot going on — but I need your help. The thing I hate most about this race is having to ask supporters like you to contribute to our campaign. name: Macky Stafford
subject: Final Week Updates!
body:
Some important reminders as we enter the final week of the campaign of our lives:

Hi Freedom Lovers, Truth Warriors & Soon-to-be-Winners:

Some important reminders as we enter the final week of the campaign of our lives:

ONE DAY VOTING:

No early voting, spread the word!! The attorneys helping us have advised us all to vote as late in the day on Tuesday the 8th as possible. Let’s all pray we wait in historically long lines and while we are standing in line, inform fellow voters to only vote on paper once in the polls: no touch screens!

PEROUTKA CAMPAIGN PRAYER SERVICE:

The most important item is the next Peroutka Prayer Service. Please organize groups now to gather on Sunday evening at 7:30pm to watch the Prayer Service together in groups. Our prayers are much stronger when we are gathered together. Please plan accordingly so we can have participation in all 24 jurisdictions. If you are hosting or involved in a group (big or small) please email back so we can be sure every county and the city are all represented. The last prayer service got TREMENDOUS reviews and was the highlight of the entire campaign thus far. Michael is truly looking forward to the one on Sunday (really, he keeps asking when it is, he cannot wait). Please join us, you will be so uplifted, as everyone always is when they see Michael playing guitar & singing.

Peroutka Campaign Prayer Service: 7:30 pm Sunday - Here’s the link: Please share far & wide to ensure a huge turnout!

https://d2C1H704.na1.hubspotlinksstarter.com/Ctc/L0+113/d2C1H704/VWLCVM4_2d2QW5S67Dm4yjH4wW6cqVBw4RQDkmN1FQ0sp3l0fcV1-WJV7CgGfpW5KBKbk5-scDbW41sgq_6G7FrBW59TDf_6L_dYTW45sQvm467VDwVzBvhd2rMjP1W67-QDB11-ZQwW2yDTpV2hHwTsW3Vf0R45KXXrVW23cl9h7b6J6FW4n7B2q7j0xLBW5kSX977JNRZlW3p52v15l9vmsW6Xgmzr6nldSsN48FvQ_hxBg-W7Ppypw7-ny69W3pdVVR8ZMj4LW8sNCT71yrl33VczWLF493-q8W3L9gZh39Qg7FW5_b5V_8gDbsY3gl91 (https://d2C1H704.na1.hubspotlinksstarter.com/Ctc/L0+113/d2C1H704/VWLCVM4_2d2QW5S67Dm4yjH4wW6cqVBw4RQDkmN1FQ0sp3l0fcV1-WJV7CgGfpW5KBKbk5-scDbW41sgq_6G7FrBW59TDf_6L_dYTW45sQvm467VDwVzBvhd2rMjP1W67-QDB11-ZQwW2yDTpV2hHwTsW3Vf0R45KXXrVW23cl9h7b6J6FW4n7B2q7j0xLBW5kSX977JNRZlW3p52v15l9vmsW6Xgmzr6nldSsN48FvQ_hxBg-W7Ppypw7-ny69W3pdVVR8ZMj4LW8sNCT71yrl33VczWLF493-q8W3L9gZh39Qg7FW5_b5V_8gDbsY3gl91 )

POLL WATCHING:

More information coming out in addition to this about being a Poll Watcher (aka Poll Challenger), but the most important three things to know are: 1- we need many more people: please sign up at CitizenVoter22@gmail.com (mailto:CItizenVoter22@gmail.com) for every bit of information you need.

2- it’s already working, stories are coming in and we have attorneys helping us! We need more “eyes & ears” in the polls, though, so please everyone take a turn. It’s rewarding to take play a crucial part in establishing free & fair elections.

3- even if you are poll watching on your own or through another group or organization, would you please email CitizenVoter22@gmail.com (mailto:CitizenVoter22@gmail.com) to get on our central list? Many of us are involved, but we are stronger together and if we can send out messages from the attorneys working the War Room, we can keep all of us informed faster and more effectively.

Poll Challenger: CitizenVoter22@gmail.com (mailto:CitizenVoter22@gmail.com)

ELECTION FRAUD HOTLINE:

If everyone could save this number as a contact in your phones so you will have it if/when you need it, it would be very helpful. This is the voter fraud hotline you can call if you witness anything suspicious when you go to vote: 410-210-4450. This includes if you go to vote and when you check in, you are informed that you have already voted. You can also email: Help@MD.ProtectTheVote.com (mailto:Help@MD.ProtectTheVote.com) . Please share this information far & wide.

ELECTIONEERING:

Email back if you would like some palm cards to hand out at any one of the polling locations. Early voting locations are different than the sites on the 8th, but we need volunteers at all locations. We also need people to drive around and make sure every single Republican table/tent at polling locations has plenty of Peroutka palm cards. Let us know if you need a stack! It’s easy and it works...please help out....we need to fight hard until the very end.

AMAZING GRACE:

At the rally in Hampstead on Friday, something spectacular happened. We arrived on a chilly and kinda dreary, cloudy day. Not exactly cold, not raining, just not the kind of gorgeous day you would want for an outdoor event. Michael spoke, the crowd loved him, of course, and then Dr. Alan Keyes spoke. Before the next speakers took the stage, Michael grabbed his guitar and asked his dear friend Alan Keyes to join him singing “Amazing Grace.” Just as they began singing the sun came out as radiantly as it ever could, warming the hillside and the hearts of the fans alike. It was beautiful. It was just beautiful. Stay tuned for the video or keep an eye on the Patriots4Peroutka site to see it. Here’s a photo of Michael & Alan Keyes singing, with Dan Cox and Fr. James Altman in the background:

Thanks so much for all of your hard, hard work. We are truly blessed to be here for a time such as this.

Keep the Faith, Fans, and Flood the Polls on the 8th!

Full of gratitude,

Macky Stafford

Campaign Coordinator, Peroutka for Attorney General, State of Maryland

name: Connor Boyack
subject: Get the truth about these 40 political myths
body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true. It’s a narrative that you’ll often see

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ztrt1plird0hrp5ln7mlepgjs533pu6fiqdl5j1g_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9j64o35cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2za7ssifjdtb11dlic2l1hr7thkko11c89vqvfdio_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9j64o35cjh2bs)**
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zebihoij8ihj0b9nh22pk1vc5cdeovb3s9vc0tb8_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9j64o35cjh2bs)
---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

You can get your free copy using this secure link:

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zffcmg991n49bgnbeefi7lq4v07lqsl6k6p2n28g_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9j64o35cjh2bs)**

I'd also love for you to share this book with at least 5 people you know--especially any children in your family. My hope is that they will enjoy the same benefits you do when you read this book. And then, we can crush these myths once and for all.

Please use this link to get instant access to your free copy of _**[The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zar176l6apufoj2gc62c0qrbj6hqmgk2qbm2e488_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9j64o35cjh2bs)**_ today!
Thank you,

Connor Boyack
Author, Tuttle Twins
Founder, Libertas Institute

[Please give a critical $25, $50, $100 or more IMMEDIATELY to fully fund my two crucial lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE.
](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhrsm00llekd9ugvn9f6e0qec1gsi6p2e9sa3ki0_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9j64p35chh2bs)
Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.
**
Zach didn’t attack the U.S. Capitol Police. (His own father and grandfather were Philadelphia cops, like my brother, for Pete’s sake.)

Zach didn’t break anything, or even hurt anyone’s feelings with harsh words.

**He simply exercised his right to free speech as an American citizen.
**
But because he’s a member of the Proud Boys, Joe Biden’s Department of Justice has charged him with seditious conspiracy.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

**What’s more, he hasn’t had the chance to hold his baby girl even once.
**
**And to add insult to injury, the VA notified his wife, Amanda, that they were cutting off Zach’s disability payments because he’d been charged with seditious conspiracy. Just charged – not convicted!
**
As you can imagine, all of this has been brutally hard on Zach, his wife, and two daughters. No freedom...no rights...no due process...IN AMERICA!

**Patriot, that’s why I’ve filed two critically important class action lawsuits on behalf of each and every January 6 Peaceful Protester who are getting brutally abused by the justice system as I write you this urgent email.
**
If the Biden Justice Department and its FBI can push around and seek to destroy a peaceful, disabled Marine veteran for exercising his right to free speech, they can push you and me, our families, friends, and fellow Americans around, too.

You and I, and the people we love in are in grave danger.

Zach warns about that in a letter to his wife:

** “They are jailing innocent people on bogus and trumped-up charges because those people simply supported the sitting president Donald Trump at the time; which is absolutely insane. If you think it can’t happen to you, look at me, because if it can happen to me, trust me, it can happen to you.”
**
That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.
](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3ojgggtn433e3r3mgbd7nua3b367n3gv3dge0i8_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9j64p35chh2bs)
I’m using two powerful lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to do this.

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, Zach Rehl is one of many good Americans enduring abuse and heartbreaking suffering right now just because they spoke out peacefully on January 6th.

We no longer live in a democracy, but instead a Biden “Gestapo Police State!” This CANNOT and WILL NOT stand! The Republicans are doing NOTHING about this, BUT WE WILL!

[Please help me fight for these peaceful January 6 protesters in court with your best gift of $25, $50, $100, or more right away.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8f3s3mn93raqid4ip4r3dc949qg6lrosal6hhl0_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9j64p35chh2bs)

Peter,I know that your inbox is **full** of candidates from across this nation asking you for donations to their campaign. After all, today is October 31st and it is the final major campaign deadline of the 2022 cycle.I want to give you some great news, though. Our campaign is exceeding every expectation in Virginia’s 3rd District. So many people counted our campaign out and didn’t believe we could win — but every metric that I’m seeing is pointing towards a big victory for this campaign. **But, we need to make sure we don’t fall behind now.**

He’s done NOTHING to combat the disastrous inflation. I’ll definitely fight inflation. American families CANNOT make ends meet because of this. Just look at the facts:
* Eggs are[ UP 39.8%](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=1743308ce6&e=fdefed58de)

* Bread is[ UP 16.2%](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=a8b093098e&e=fdefed58de)
* Electricity is[ UP 15.8%](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=fdc0569232&e=fdefed58de)
* Transportation services are[ UP 11.3%](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=4ee2c4fbef&e=fdefed58de)
* The median annual rent for Americans is [UP 10%](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=89caf1edc5&e=fdefed58de) compared to last August.
* Biden’s inflation crisis has cost the average American worker[ OVER $3,000](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=9a37053f21&e=fdefed58de)in annual income.

---
[**‘America’s greatest mayor’ endorses James Judge for Congress as CD-14 race looks like possible upset for Democrats**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=14022cfa1d&e=00028e5542)
_Former St. Petersburg Mayor Rick Baker endorsed James Judge for Congress on Monday. In the last week, Judge also earned the endorsements of the Florida Police Benevolent Association and Senator Rick Scott._ ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. – Former St. Petersburg Mayor Rick Baker, who was extremely popular with bi-partisan support during his tenure and once called “America’s best mayor” by the Daily Beast, endorsed James Judge for Congress, the Judge campaign announced Monday.Judge is running an energetic, grassroots campaign to represent the cities of Tampa and St. Petersburg in the U.S. House of Representatives and to replace liberal Democrat Rep. Kathy Castor (D-FL), who has been in office since 2006.“James Judge understands that the average American is suffering under the results of the current Democrat Party leadership – high inflation, plunging retirement savings, rampant crime in our cities, and open borders,” said Baker. “He is committed to bringing conservative leadership to Congress – his first vote will be to remove Nancy Pelosi from the Speaker’s chair.”Baker served as mayor of St. Petersburg from 2001 until 2010. During his tenure, Baker was named America’s Mayor/Public Official of the Year by Governing Magazine, and in 2011, was recognized as “America’s greatest mayor of the decade” by Newsweek Magazine’s Daily Beast.“I am beyond grateful for Mayor Baker’s endorsement and his support. I look forward to his wise counsel once I am elected,” said Judge. “It is time for Tampa Bay area voters to put an end to the Castor regime’s reign, so we can refund our police, get tough on crime, and lower gas prices back to where they were when Republicans were in charge. I look forward to serving the people of my hometown and representing them in the U.S. House of Representatives.”Judge squares off with Castor in the Nov. 8 general election.Judge has also been endorsed by several additional prominent figures and organizations.They include:· Senator Rick Scott (R-FL)· Congressman Brian Mast (R-FL)· Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ)· Congressman Ted Yoho (R-FL) retired· Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard· Florida Police Benevolent Association· Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri· The Tampa Police Benevolent Association· Pinellas County Sheriff Jim Coats (retired)· Associated Builders and Contractors Florida Gulf Coast· The Community Patriots Tampa· Republican strategist Roger Stone· Chris Chambers, former Congressional candidate and community leader· Matt Becker, small business owner, former SBA White House Deputy Chief, and former Congressional Candidate**About James Judge:
** Judge, a Tampa Bay area native, is the Republican nominee for Florida’s 14th Congressional District. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and was deployed to Iraq in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom while serving in the U.S. Coast Guard. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011 under General David Petraeus. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the National Rifle Association, Veterans of Foreign Wars, the American Legion, the Tampa Propeller Club and the Coastal Conservation Association. The Judges are also long-time, active members of Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

name: This is Steve Scalise
subject: OUR LAST AND FINAL DEADLINE
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
I just huddled with my finance team:
Peter --
**I won 't waste a moment of your time. Our LAST AND FINAL DEADLINE of the election cycle is tonight. **
[**The Democrats are crushing us in fundraising in the most important races in America, and we 're in urgent need of emergency reinforcements or we could lose the House and Senate. I'm personally asking you to make one last contribution now that we're just 200 hours out from Election Day.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61769827:JettTsGND:m:1:3346849603:2B6BAE8450AB80F8C42414E642FC781D:r)
****[FINAL DEADLINE: SEND REINFORCEMENTS >>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61769827:JettTsGND:m:1:3346849603:2B6BAE8450AB80F8C42414E642FC781D:r)****
Everything we've worked for over the last two years comes down to this final sprint. Our final Get-Out-The-Vote and voter contact operations are running full speed ahead but we've run into a big problem.
_Democrat Super PACs and Liberal billionaires just unloaded millions of dollars in an eleventh-hour blitz to defeat us in the last phase of the midterm elections._
**I just huddled with my finance team. We agreed Republicans have to raise another $50,000 before our final deadline or we won 't be able to fight back...** [**And the damage to our GOP candidates would be irreversible. I know that's a lofty goal, but that's what it will take to win so I'm asking you to dig deep.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61769828:JettTsGND:m:1:3346849603:2B6BAE8450AB80F8C42414E642FC781D:r)
****[FINAL DEADLINE: SEND REINFORCEMENTS >>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61769827:JettTsGND:m:1:3346849603:2B6BAE8450AB80F8C42414E642FC781D:r)****
Listen, I know how much you've sacrificed to get us this far. Your hard work and dedication are an inspiration, and everything we've accomplished to date is because of you. I can't thank you enough.
But now that we're finally pulling into the station, we can't stumble now -- not if we want to win!
So, if you have the grit and determination to keep fighting until the final race is called, I'm respectfully asking you to step up ONE LAST TIME. **The Democrats are unleashing a last-minute blitz to wipe out our path to victory. I hate to say it, but this could take them over the top unless we respond before our midnight deadline.**
[**THE FINAL DEADLINE TO STOP THEM IS RIGHT NOW.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61769827:JettTsGND:m:1:3346849603:2B6BAE8450AB80F8C42414E642FC781D:r)
_So, what are you going to do, Patriot???_
To victory,
Steve Scalise
* * *
_[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61769829:JettTsGND:m:1:3346849603:2B6BAE8450AB80F8C42414E642FC781D:r)_
__
Can you keep this between us? Pollsters, pundits, and the media are saying the unthinkable -- Pelosi and the Democrats have a chance to defeat us. And with hundreds of millions of dollars in their war chest to spend attacking us -- they're going ALL IN.
We'll say it straight: we're being outraised. And if we sit here and do nothing, Pelosi and the Democrats will buy this election from under us. [**If you 've been waiting to step up, now is the time. Everything President Trump worked so hard to build -- our Conservative Supreme Court Majority, a secure border, a booming economy, HIS ENTIRE LEGACY -- is on the line.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61769829:JettTsGND:m:1:3346849603:2B6BAE8450AB80F8C42414E642FC781D:r)
We still have time to turn things around, but we need to act fast. Whether we win or lose will come down to what you do in this moment.
\-- Steve Scalise, House Republican Whip

We have endorsed candidates up and down the ballot across the country. With your help, we can keep the Senate and the House of Republicans in Democratic control. **Please don 't take this lightly, losing just a few elections could put Republicans back in charge of Congress, where they can advance a pro-NRA agenda, strip away women's rights, and stall the Democratic agenda. ** **[Don't boo, donate! Help us defend our Democratic majority in Congress, with candidates who will stand up to the gun lobby, not bow down to it like Republicans do. It's not too late to make a difference this election - donate here.](https://act.myngp.com/el/BSqFlHSoANjZwe2RINXOQihyiKay9dBuwaS06ezm3IQ=/6SzE58gu2NPoDW0fx0NkjfrP2TdpAad-WnJu2nKtRLE=?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes)** [](https://act.myngp.com/el/BSqFlHSoANjZwe2RINXOQihyiKay9dBuwaS06ezm3IQ=/6SzE58gu2NPoDW0fx0NkjfrP2TdpAad-WnJu2nKtRLE=?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes) In the last few days before Election Day, there is still so much we can do to help candidates who are in tight races that will determine control of Congress. The Fake News Media is coming after me.
The Fake News Media is coming after me.

Friend,
---
CNN is rushing to the defense of their beloved Gretchen Whitmer.
---
**They just published a hit piece accusing me of “peddling conspiracy theories.”**
---
_The “conspiracy theory” they’re referring to? I said that Democrats like Whitmer have worked for decades to divide America so they can push their radical, freedom-crushing agenda!_
---
_The Fake News Media is FURIOUS their favorite candidate Gretchen Whitmer is losing, so they’re coming after me to try and sabotage our campaign now that we’ve surged into the lead._
---
**_With only DAYS to go until Election Day, we can’t let their slanderous attacks go unanswered – but I need your help to fight back and get the TRUTH out to the voters._**

The Fake News Media HATES that a pro-Trump, America First conservative is about to defeat Gretchen Whitmer and win the most important governor’s race in the country.
---
**That’s why they’ve resorted to LYING about me and my campaign.**
---
Unfortunately, I’m not surprised. CNN and the liberal media did everything they could to sabotage President Trump from the day he announced he was running for President.
---
Now, they’re doing the _exact_ same thing to me.
---
**After Whitmer’s disastrous debate performance, they know she has NO CHANCE of winning this race on the issues...**
---
_...so they’re using lies and exaggerations to try and torpedo us at the final hour._
---
Friend, I’m confident we’re going to win, but this race is going to be extremely close.

We can’t afford to lose a single vote because of these absurd attacks.

**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents - AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

Larry Klayman

clean_body: | Team, Tell me if you've heard this one before: This upcoming election is the most important one we've had in years. It's true that every election is important. But it's also true that the election taking place in less than 8 days could reverberate for decades. I believe in our democracy, but some of the Republicans running for office this year don't seem to. They've shown that they're willing to do just about anything to get elected and hang onto power – even if it means ignoring the will of the people. If Republicans succeed this time, they could do irrevocable damage to a system of government that, while imperfect, has served our country for almost 250 years. That's why I support the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, which is working to protect our voting rights and help elect candidates who will uphold and strengthen our democracy. These days, it's easy to get numb to the constant threats to our democracy, or tune out the latest outrage. But ignoring what's happening won't solve anything. Instead, we have to confront our challenges head-on, and put everything we have into strengthening our democracy at the polls, in the courts, and everywhere else. Inflation, crime, open borders, fentanyl, life, our Second Amendment, farmers, and more are on the ballot this November. Much more important than me, at this point in time, is getting Bob Good, Yesli Vega, Rob Wittman, and the rest of our congressional delegation elected this November. Please pray, vote, volunteer, and help spread the word so that we can win back Congress and stop the Biden White House. I'm working on legislation for 2023. Peter,

Every year, before Election Day I make a plan to vote. My vote is too important to leave to chance — and so is yours. **[Tomorrow is the last day you can request a mail-in ballot](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53710333/376240981/-1813083118?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhZWYyMi0yMDU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6xMwYBSiQPyo3TE0QQI_ShqXBSlB2shJNQulsZKznAc=&emci=cb4ce74f-9a54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=658aef22-2059-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=5086640#/OnlineAbsenteeBegin)** , so now is the perfect time to make your plan to vote. Any single vote could decide our future, including yours. **First, decide how you will vote:**
* Will you vote by mail? It's the easiest way to vote and a great way to help your candidate win. **[If you plan to vote by mail, request a ballot online right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53710334/376240988/-1813083118?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhZWYyMi0yMDU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6xMwYBSiQPyo3TE0QQI_ShqXBSlB2shJNQulsZKznAc=&emci=cb4ce74f-9a54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=658aef22-2059-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=5086640#/OnlineAbsenteeBegin)**
* Or, will you vote on Election Day?

**Second, find out where you vote:**
* **[Pennsylvania voters can find out where and how to vote at Vote.PA.gov.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53710335/376240995/-43166214?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhZWYyMi0yMDU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6xMwYBSiQPyo3TE0QQI_ShqXBSlB2shJNQulsZKznAc=&emci=cb4ce74f-9a54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=658aef22-2059-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=5086640)**
* **[Everyone else can visit IWillVote.com.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53710336/376241002/-1612268846?state=pa&source=arkoosh&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhZWYyMi0yMDU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6xMwYBSiQPyo3TE0QQI_ShqXBSlB2shJNQulsZKznAc=&emci=cb4ce74f-9a54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=658aef22-2059-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=5086640)**

**Third, decide how you'll get to your polling place or deliver your mail-in ballot:**
* If you plan to use a mail-in ballot, you can drop it in your mailbox, **[find a dropbox at Vote.PA.gov](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53710337/376241005/-797440119?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhZWYyMi0yMDU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6xMwYBSiQPyo3TE0QQI_ShqXBSlB2shJNQulsZKznAc=&emci=cb4ce74f-9a54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=658aef22-2059-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=5086640)** , or return it to your County Voter Services office.
* If you're voting in-person, now is the time to decide:
* How will you get there? Do you need a ride?
* Will you bring someone with you?
* When will you vote?

By making a plan now, you can make history in this election. **[Visit Vote.PA.gov to find out the details on when, where, and how you can vote in Pennsylvania](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53710338/376241006/-43166214?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhZWYyMi0yMDU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6xMwYBSiQPyo3TE0QQI_ShqXBSlB2shJNQulsZKznAc=&emci=cb4ce74f-9a54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=658aef22-2059-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=5086640)** , or **[visit IWillVote.com if you're planning on voting in another state.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53710339/376241007/-1612268846?state=pa&source=arkoosh&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NThhZWYyMi0yMDU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6xMwYBSiQPyo3TE0QQI_ShqXBSlB2shJNQulsZKznAc=&emci=cb4ce74f-9a54-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=658aef22-2059-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=5086640)** Thanks for being a voter,

| | **_The end of the Democratic Party?_**

Peter, this is Mayra Flores, Catalina Lauf, and Cassy Garcia.

You probably don't know us, but we're three America-First Hispanic women running in the three districts that will decide the fate of the Democratic Party.

For years, they assumed we would just fall in line and vote Democrat because we have brown skin.

_**They were wrong.**_

As Hispanic women, and proud conservative Americans, we never fell in line with the liberal agenda because we have thick skin, not just brown.

_**The GOP is color blind. The Dems are not. It's that simple.**_

And the Hispanic community is waking up to this at levels we've never seen.

This is exactly why Nancy Pelosi is spending millions against us in our must-win races, to shut us down in revenge.

And it's working- Pelosi is shattering every known fundraising record and hitting us with everything she's got. She knows that if we win the Hispanic vote for the first time in American history- her days are numbered.

More importantly, the Democratic Party's days are numbered.

**With this historic movement of Hispanic voters to the GOP, our party will never lose an election again.**

So, we're pleading with you today, please help us out with just a few bucks?

body:
Help me support Jevin Hodge's Campaign in Arizona's 1st Congressional District
Friend,
I just got back from a stop on my "Protect our Democracy Tour" in Arizona where I worked to get out the vote for Jevin Hodge, an inspiring young candidate polling evenly against the election-denying GOP incumbent David Schweikert.
David Schweikert is just one of 11 Representatives in our country's history to be formall reprimanded on the House floor for misusing our hard-earned taxpayer dollars, and he is firmly against the fundamental right to an abortion. Recently, he voted against lowering prescription drug costs for seniors.
Friend, we need Jevin in Congress.
Jevin knows the economic pain facing so many Americans. Raised by a single mom and on food stamps, he has seen first-hand how our government can help those who need it the most. He graduated from George Washington University and now leads the longest-running Head Start program in Arizona.
Jevin would make history as the first African-American to ever represent Arizona in Congress. At 28 years old, he would also become one of the youngest members of Congress, ushering in much-needed generational change.
Now, more than ever, we need democracy champions in Congress who understand the struggles of working families. Having known him for years, I’m convinced Jevin Hodge is that person. He has what it takes to change the status quo while protecting the progress we’ve made thus far.
_**I was proud to make Jevin one of Policy is Personal PAC’s earliest endorsed candidates, which helped him win his primary. Now I’m asking you to join his diverse coalition of supporters and elect him to the House in Arizona’s 1st Congressional District. ## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

# Colorado Lost Two Great Leaders
---
|
---
| Two great friends and leaders recently passed away, Colorado House Minority Leader Hugh McKean and President of the Southern Christian Leadership Conference Henry Allen. My condolences and prayers go out to all who are hurting from the sudden and unexpected passing of these remarkable men. May we never forget their fortitude and desire to see positive change throughout this wonderful state.
