What feels like extra may be just enough to do what’s right.

Derek, in a minute, I’m going to tell you a personal story about why I’m running to create a better Georgia for all — without raising a single cent in taxes. **[However, if you don’t have the time to read the whole thing, can you split a donation between my campaign and Josh Shapiro's before you close this email, to build a country where everyone can thrive, before you go? Anything you can give will make a real difference to our grassroots campaigns.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53735672/376331912/221824738?refcode=email_103122_eomabrams_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=7f551c1c-4659-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjU1MWMxYy00NjU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RaeR3PKCGU9becxF43RhFmcDFYzWBBAJBsY8fZe-o_A=)** When I was 10 or so, I got to go with my grandfather to the neighborhood gas station. With five siblings and nine cousins, alone time with him was a rare treat. I chattered the whole way there about books and school and summer plans. When we arrived, I proudly went inside to pay to fill up the tank and to buy some candy. On our way home, I told Granddaddy a secret — _the man at the store had given me too much change._ My grandfather whipped his car around and drove back to the station in silence. As he pulled in front of the store, he turned to me with a look of disappointment. He told me that what I had didn’t belong to me. Instead, by keeping the extra money, I had put that attendant in jeopardy. His stern face softened, and he explained, what felt like a win to me meant that someone else would be paying the bill. Technically, yes, I could have it, but at what cost? My job was to go back inside and tell the truth. To return the money so that man could take care of his responsibilities. I dutifully got out of the car and gave the gentleman the extra $5. His look of relief and surprise were their own rewards — and I got a piece of bubblegum for my trouble. What my grandfather taught me that day was profound: **what feels like extra may be just enough to do what’s right.** Losing that $5 might have cost that man his job or made it so he couldn’t get home to his family. I’ll never know, and I don’t need to. **Because Derek, I live this lesson every day. We can do what’s right for Georgia — by investing in our economy, saving health care, building infrastructure, and taking care of our small businesses, our workers, and our bottom line. We can turn our state around and give back what has been taken from too many Georgians.** In November, we will set our course for the next generation. We can choose a governor who will deploy the largest surplus in a generation in a way that’s right — or one who will give it to his friends. **[Together, we can do the right thing. Derek, will you split a contribution between me and Josh Shapiro to power our campaigns right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53735673/376331913/221824738?refcode=email_103122_eomabrams_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=7f551c1c-4659-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjU1MWMxYy00NjU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RaeR3PKCGU9becxF43RhFmcDFYzWBBAJBsY8fZe-o_A=)** Thank you, Stacey Abrams ******** ******** ******** ******** ******** ******** ******** ******** ******** ******** ******** ********

clean_body: What feels like extra may be just enough to do what’s right. Derek, in a minute, I’m going to tell you a personal story about why I’m running to create a better Georgia for all — without raising a single cent in taxes. = When I was 10 or so, I got to go with my grandfather to the neighborhood gas station. With five siblings and nine cousins, alone time with him was a rare treat. I chattered the whole way there about books and school and summer plans. When we arrived, I proudly went inside to pay to fill up the tank and to buy some candy. On our way home, I told Granddaddy a secret — the man at the store had given me too much change. My grandfather whipped his car around and drove back to the station in silence. As he pulled in front of the store, he turned to me with a look of disappointment. He told me that what I had didn’t belong to me. Instead, by keeping the extra money, I had put that attendant in jeopardy. His stern face softened, and he explained, what felt like a win to me meant that someone else would be paying the bill. Technically, yes, I could have it, but at what cost? My job was to go back inside and tell the truth. To return the money so that man could take care of his responsibilities. I dutifully got out of the car and gave the gentleman the extra $5. His look of relief and surprise were their own rewards — and I got a piece of bubblegum for my trouble. What my grandfather taught me that day was profound: what feels like extra may be just enough to do what’s right. Losing that $5 might have cost that man his job or made it so he couldn’t get home to his family. I’ll never know, and I don’t need to. Because Derek, I live this lesson every day. We can do what’s right for Georgia — by investing in our economy, saving health care, building infrastructure, and taking care of our small businesses, our workers, and our bottom line. We can turn our state around and give back what has been taken from too many Georgians. In November, we will set our course for the next generation. We can choose a governor who will deploy the largest surplus in a generation in a way that’s right — or one who will give it to his friends. = Thank you, Stacey Abrams ****** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** | | | = Text JOSH to 32210 By participating, you agree to the for recurring autodialed marketing messages from Josh Shapiro to the phone number you provide. body:
Friend - I wanted to make sure you saw the message I sent below. The GOP's attempts to win this seat are escalating as Election Day approaches, which means it's especially important that I hit my end-of-month fundraising goal today. But frankly, we still have a ways to go. I know that with supporters like you by my side, we can get back on track and ensure this seat stays blue. So with Democratic control of the Senate on the line, I have to ask: **[Will you rush a donation of $5 right now so I can hit my final end-of-month goal before the election and protect this Democratic seat?** Thanks, Dick
---
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Richard Blumenthal**
Date: Sun, Oct 30, 2022
Subject: My final, most important deadline
[](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=7eeMpun%2BuSgZpBz7YPc%2FhJaUqOYJOSmS&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F) My campaign is about to close the books on October - and our final end-of-month fundraising deadline - with a $17,441 shortfall. I need to explain to you why this cannot happen - and why I'm counting on your donation to get us back on track. **But first, let me say that I 'm deeply appreciative of your support for this campaign.** This operation is powered by people like you - people who believe in our shared Democratic values; who are committed to fighting back against Trump, McConnell, and GOP extremists everywhere; and who contribute their time and talent to protect every Democratic seat. However, we are operating with the most tenuous possible control of the Senate, which means, **_with just nine short days left in this election_** , there's no room for error or falling short on resources to protect critical seats like this one. If we lose a single seat - as Mitch McConnell is hell-bent on making happen - control of the chamber will be gone. With the National Republican Senatorial Committee already targeting me, YOUR donation will put us in the strongest possible position to defend this seat. **It 's your donation, Friend, that could prevent us from ending the month with a fundraising shortfall, that will ensure we have the resources to combat GOP attacks, and that will help us protect and EXPAND Democratic Senate control.** **But it needs to happen before tomorrow's midnight deadline.** **[So please, will you donate $5 or more to protect this Democratic Senate seat and ensure control of the Senate stays out of the hands of Mitch McConnell?**](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1288-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500) Thank you, Dick This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com.

Fellow American,

Last week former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=930081e28f9b4d9e91ec78803c95777f&_e=YlPi_kfMcy8NqbmHC8wyuyRj51CXVEAb2FC7IFHn_rMVGh2qCW-clPUAocXgWXcKgq-XY2VMdxZ_2CEBQ1bG-hT9KJDXbkQhSwYUMID2eWK0hsb8Tf3mMcijxEoQSNXQ7aEyCQMPjjfr2Ocr99PHZp--It672X2Atdc_UfjyTRBv1tZObW3kYTygnaUHIaRCm6XMlqCroIoovGLdWkFrIf2Xoo8C2FRa58zXWSthQhZL1Kd16-4AdZVfVdRZu2d_5FLuPtM265HPePyjFOmX-j8giH7OX3Ysspf-tlMmaPgHeOt436JDKQ5YzOwKNC5EYG4SjBiU68nUWpNiafwwPabpHVMEU3v3cpY8MJ3eHV2z7CqRnO-caZnIuaexp-w2wTumw08zcVFqdIFSCUe-vQ%3D%3D)
Democrats know that Georgia is KEY to the Senate majority, so they are using all their big names to make a last-minute pitch for the struggling campaigns of Warnock and Abrams.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=930081e28f9b4d9e91ec78803c95777f&_e=YlPi_kfMcy8NqbmHC8wyuyRj51CXVEAb2FC7IFHn_rMVGh2qCW-clPUAocXgWXcKgq-XY2VMdxZ_2CEBQ1bG-hT9KJDXbkQhSwYUMID2eWK0hsb8Tf3mMcijxEoQSNXQ7aEyCQMPjjfr2Ocr99PHZp--It672X2Atdc_UfjyTRBv1tZObW3kYTygnaUHIaRCm6XMlqCroIoovGLdWkFrIf2Xoo8C2FRa58zXWSthQhZL1Kd16-4AdZVfVdRZu2d_tUUEHNlWi35UZ-yhehQndUL0rmfJiBrrBD8kDl5-J9qwkmKErNUJZAi7kRzXtWUoRboj4b4Ja4yexcckq37u8O4GsAHbfr5nGi1mYo5rf7SEOiZxA_XuC7wERTmE24BqgXMIP7rRIukXhvtdbJiALw%3D%3D)
They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. And we know they're desperate because we heard it directly from Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden this week during their hot mic moment. **That's why Democrats sounded the alarm and asked President Obama to campaign in Georgia.**

_**What did President Obama have to say about me?**_ He called me a celebrity who wants to be a politician. He got that one wrong. I'm not a celebrity or your typical politician; _I'm a warrior for God._

He got something else wrong, too. He encouraged us to vote for Joe Biden two years ago, didn't he? We've all seen how that's worked out for us - record inflation, open borders, more crime, and less freedom.

**With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out.**

But here's the thing, Fellow American. President Obama's visit to Georgia will gin up Democrats and help Senator Warnock raise millions. The moment he got off the stage, my opponent was begging supporters for money.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=930081e28f9b4d9e91ec78803c95777f&_e=YlPi_kfMcy8NqbmHC8wyuyRj51CXVEAb2FC7IFHn_rMVGh2qCW-clPUAocXgWXcKgq-XY2VMdxZ_2CEBQ1bG-hT9KJDXbkQhSwYUMID2eWK0hsb8Tf3mMcijxEoQSNXQ7aEyCQMPjjfr2Ocr99PHZp--It672X2Atdc_UfjyTRBv1tZObW3kYTygnaUHIaRCm6XMlqCroIoovGLdWkFrIf2Xoo8C2FRa58zXWSthQhZL1Kd16-4AdZVfVdRZu2d_CwMOT5VXwOclwusbPj1N6xhmio7Dm4QLGGDsH5fb6OKOGNaRgD4PK6K803iVpzlfD78ArCBplBYKcqUGNzXDD3Eyw1UkTz1jJnx16A5RcbQ9pfctxZ5xIwlQyUdMYy-vg6Ipk3IqRvQ58hV3WBXrlQ%3D%3D)
**[I need your help. We're being outraised by millions, and the gap is growing with President Obama's visit. Will you chip in $5, $10, or even $34 today?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=930081e28f9b4d9e91ec78803c95777f&_e=YlPi_kfMcy8NqbmHC8wyuyRj51CXVEAb2FC7IFHn_rMVGh2qCW-clPUAocXgWXcKgq-XY2VMdxZ_2CEBQ1bG-hT9KJDXbkQhSwYUMID2eWK0hsb8Tf3mMcijxEoQSNXQ7aEyCQMPjjfr2Ocr99PHZp--It672X2Atdc_UfjyTRBv1tZObW3kYTygnaUHIaRCm6XMlqCroIoovGLdWkFrIf2Xoo8C2FRa58zXWSthQhZL1Kd16-4AdZVfVdRZu2d_fbTr9qRTDXApzkBBJpVvDWalUG0OIfV4JJFx2v17r1LJGDj4PEBhbfcqJbtHuqeWx3GMUKonlXYTxGXNbipr3jBjBsPFjDxxVKM5QSYabxeYw8dI3TMqWO6pNH_Vhz-OU89I0nfvwqESsu-jiuy4kQ%3D%3D)**

subject: Happy Halloween, Derek!

body:
We are down to just 8 days!!!
#
Hey Derek, here’s a question:
If Congress is a Haunted House — does that make us ghostbusters? 🎃👻
All jokes aside, I’m haunted by how _little_ time left we have to ensure our campaign defeats Dr. Oz on November 8. We’re just 8 days away!!!
That’s why you keep getting my emails, receiving my texts, + seeing my ads. Because there’s absolutely *no telling* what else Oz + the MAGA Super PACs supporting him will do to spread more lies about me + our campaign.
**[We need your help to fight back, Derek. Please rush a donation of any amount today to help fund our grassroots campaign through the final days of this race, beat Dr. Oz + flip PA blue.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221031-1?refcode=em20221031-7971&refcode2=7971_434096_qcaF0S&akid=7971%2E434096%2EqcaF0S)**
**[Fight Back: Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221031-1?refcode=em20221031-7971&refcode2=7971_434096_qcaF0S&akid=7971%2E434096%2EqcaF0S)**
Don’t forget: Dr. Oz is scarier than any movie villain.
He owns a ridiculous amount of properties, became a mega-millionaire by hawking fake diet pills + snake oil on TV, and called *all* abortion “murder.” Not to mention the fact that he’s self-funding a campaign in a state he doesn’t even live in... Oh, and he's literally killed puppies.
Yes, seriously. 💔
**[We can’t let Oz anywhere near the Senate, but the polls are showing us statistically _tied_. Please rush a donation of any amount today to help fund our grassroots campaign through the final days of this race, beat Dr. Oz + flip PA blue this November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221031-1?refcode=em20221031-7971&refcode2=7971_434096_qcaF0S&akid=7971%2E434096%2EqcaF0S)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221031-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221031-7971&refcode2=7971_434096_qcaF0S&akid=7971%2E434096%2EqcaF0S)**
Thanks for taking the time to read about how important this race is today, Derek. Gisele + I hope you’re able to get outside and spend some time with family and loved ones. Maybe even trick or treat!
—John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate
P.S. Here is an ultra-rare throwback photo of me with hair. You decide whether it’s a trick or a treat. 😂

| | | Hey Friend, it's Ron Johnson.

Democrats can smell weakness, they know I'm the most vulnerable Senate Republican running for re-election...

So what are they doing?

Pumping MILLIONS into my race, running a SMEAR campaign against me, and recruiting their RADICAL LEFT allies like Cory Booker, Elizabeth Warren and AOC, to rally their liberal supporters.

**They will NEVER be content until they have ABSOLUTE power.**

And I can promise you this, if I lose, my replacement plans to help with:
❌ABOLISHING the filibuster
❌PACKING the Supreme Court
❌BANNING voter ID

So, Friend, you can see why I'm not willing to take that risk. I can't allow the fight for Freedom to go to the wayside. I can't allow Democrats to gain the 51st vote in the Senate that will grant them a rubber stamp to pass any and all far-left policies they desire.

But if I'm going to be successful I'm going to need YOUR support to win my race. This is going to be neck-to-neck. _**[Anything you can give, $5, $18, $35, would go a long ways towards helping me fight back. Friend, can you help out?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4dk55p18miqultkrovhft00lqd4aih5l2efgdd0_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9gm0or7c9h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Ron Johnson

When we started this work almost 10 years ago, talking about gun safety in tough races would have been absolutely unthinkable to most people.
#

Friends -
As we approach another election, I want to say thank you.
When we started this work almost 10 years ago, talking about gun safety in tough races would have been absolutely unthinkable to most people.
Today, it’s a winning issue.
That is, in large part, because of the grassroots movement we’ve built together over the years.
But our work is far from over. We have a president willing to sign strong gun safety laws into law and we must do all we can to elect a Congress willing to get them to him.
But that is not something I can do alone. As I have from the start, I need your help to get it done. So with our final monthly fundraising drive coming to an end tonight, I am sincerely asking:

body:
Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $370. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6201%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=zCzdDnO%2fhD0GluECPv0Uqg&sysid=1)
The only thing I’m guilty of is making my opponent and national Democrats spend money to defend a congressional seat they think belongs to them | [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80757%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sYHscXn9f9l7eksNH9E4uw&sysid=1)

Fellow Conservative,

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I’m being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

**Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $370.** If you read the note yesterday morning, then you may recall that needed that email to raise $10,038- more than**_27 times what we wound up raising by the day’s end._**

I don’t want to sound like an alarmist, but yesterday’s fundraising totals shocked me to the core. We’re 11 days out from Election Day and must meet very real fundraising goals to keep our campaign fully funded through November 8th.**If we have another day like yesterday today, tomorrow, or any day left remaining in this campaign, then flipping this seat is probably not going to happen.**

**[Are you able to kick-in $5, $10 or $15 right now to help us make up yesterday’s missed fundraising goal?](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80758%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Cz2uM3NzfTA6zsaAEcD4BA&sysid=1)**

| [**$4**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80759%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jyKFtkoOzXqzPRzJVGcRvQ&sysid=1) | | [**$10**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80750%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gc5kVc6Xu0C%2fIFz8X1GS4Q&sysid=1) | | [**$25 **](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80751%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6VjxyykK%2bRhq6mG453b7GA&sysid=1)
---|---|---|---|---
[**$50**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80752%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Sa4%2b5k6lg%2fhpxyneYmUxoA&sysid=1) | | [**$100 **](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80753%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=15pgIQD7qUtz%2bDZr0trAkg&sysid=1) | | [** $250 **](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80754%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3JoFGqwMPeiNMhN8hLGLrA&sysid=1)

Fellow Conservative, my opponent and Democrat Super PACs are spending more than $1 million to destroy my good name, and it’s working. **Two weeks out from Election Day, we’re now trailing our opponent by one point**.

Democrats want nothing more than to destroy me. They have held onto this seat since 1972 and **their worst fear is losing it to a 30-year-old Republican**.

**[I’m praying that you’ll come through for me today.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c80765%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FqMDBDMB21rG%2b%2bAbRbMrkg&sysid=1)** We cannot allow this campaign to run of fumes for the last two weeks.

Respectfully,

subject: I’m fighting for everyone in PA who’s gotten knocked down and had to get back up.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
| | |
---
Hi friend, it’s John Fetterman.
Last week I debated Dr. Oz in Harrisburg.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

---
Peter,

Last week former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61770781:61Y7psGN9:m:1:3350876382:732D9F0D737702DE00A27C372BD075A8:r)
Democrats know that Georgia is KEY to the Senate majority, so they are using all their big names to make a last-minute pitch for the struggling campaigns of Warnock and Abrams.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61770781:61Y7psGN9:m:1:3350876382:732D9F0D737702DE00A27C372BD075A8:r)
They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. And we know they're desperate because we heard it directly from Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden this week during their hot mic moment. **That's why Democrats sounded the alarm and asked President Obama to campaign in Georgia.**

_**What did President Obama have to say about me?**_ He called me a celebrity who wants to be a politician. He got that one wrong. I'm not a celebrity or your typical politician; _I'm a warrior for God._

He got something else wrong, too. He encouraged us to vote for Joe Biden two years ago, didn't he? We've all seen how that's worked out for us - record inflation, open borders, more crime, and less freedom.

**With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out.**

But here's the thing, Peter. President Obama's visit to Georgia will gin up Democrats and help Senator Warnock raise millions. The moment he got off the stage, my opponent was begging supporters for money.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61770781:61Y7psGN9:m:1:3350876382:732D9F0D737702DE00A27C372BD075A8:r)
**[I need your help. We're being outraised by millions, and the gap is growing with President Obama's visit. Will you chip in $5, $10, or even $34 today?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61770781:61Y7psGN9:m:1:3350876382:732D9F0D737702DE00A27C372BD075A8:r)**

Thanks for standing with me in these final days.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61770781:61Y7psGN9:m:1:3350876382:732D9F0D737702DE00A27C372BD075A8:r)

Herschel Walker

But, if we're going to do it, then I need you to contribute to my campaign during this last stretch so I can finish what we started >>. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/letsfinishthis]

Let's get to work !

Sadly, this tragedy may have been preventable. **** Make no mistake, we are now feeling the consequences of the GOP’s refusal to act on climate change. **** How many more lives must be lost before the GOP finally agrees to do something to address the climate crisis?

clean_body: | | Friend, For years, climate activists have warned that we’d see more and more natural disasters as the climate crisis gets worse and worse. ** Now, we’ve seen Hurricane Ian take the lives of countless Floridians and the homes and livelihoods of many more. Sadly, this tragedy may have been preventable. Make no mistake, we are now feeling the consequences of the GOP’s refusal to act on climate change. ** How many more lives must be lost before the GOP finally agrees to do something to address the climate crisis? | We can make a difference in our life here in Southwest Florida and for the lives of our children. But we must take decisive action now. It’s past time to act on climate change and save our planet. If we continue to ignore the climate crisis, disasters like Hurricane Ian will become the norm. We need leaders that understand the risks of climate change and make investments to help. Leaders like Byron Donalds that take from Big Oil are not the answer. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: Sincerely, Dr. Cindy Banyai Democrat for Congress, FL-19 | Friends of Cindy Banyai PO Box 2923 Fort Myers, FL 33902 | | | Sent via . It is all on the line. November 8, Election Day, is 8 days away.
Tragedy will happen to parental rights and our election process if these left-wing extreme proposals pass.
WE CANNOT LET THAT HAPPEN!
There is hope. But do not rest!
Multiple grassroots efforts have educated countless voters on the dangers of these radical proposed Constitutional changes. Do NOT let up!

No rest! We Must Not Stop Now!

Proposal 1 \- Doubles the term limit of State Reps (6 years to 12), 33% longer for State Senators (8 years to 12), and makes lobbyist more powerful in Lansing.
VOTE NO!
Proposal 2 \- Eliminates voter ID requirements, allows billionaires to fund and control our elections, and stop citizens from auditing election results. Makes government and corporations more powerful.
VOTE NO!
Proposal 3 \- Eliminates parental rights regarding minors access to abortion, sterilization, and sex change surgery. Protects late term abortions and doctors that perform infanticide. Great for human traffickers, sexual abusers, and pedophiles.
VOTE NO!
SAVE MICHIGAN!

# **Independent Poll Tracker
Shows CA-09 Now Tied**
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA - Josh Harder has spent more than $4 Million on demonstratively false and misleading ads - but voters aren't buying it.

Independent and internal polling shows the race has tightened into a tie during the final days. Real Clear Politics initially ranked the CA-09 race as “lean Democrat.” A few days ago it changed that to “toss up.”

After moving into the district earlier this year, Harder began his campaign with a 14-point lead, and almost immediately launched a negative campaign. The worn-out strategy of mudslinging and false accusations might have worked in the past, but today voters are looking for real answers to address real issues of skyrocketing inflation, gas prices, crime, homelessness, and drug overdoses.

“Voters are tired of politicians throwing mud at each other,” County Supervisor and Congressional Candidate Tom Patti said. “They want to know what they plan to do to lessen their pain. But Harder cannot run on the issues because his and Nancy Pelosi’s policies are the cause of these problems,” Patti said.

Harder’s smear campaign has been called out by multiple media fact-checkers as false. Consider the below:

❌ LIE: “Supervisor Tom Patti Voted to Raise the Gas Tax by 40%.”
✅ TRUTH: The _Sacramento Bee_ fact checked the claim and reported it to be false: “Tom Patti did not vote to raise the gas tax despite Josh Harder ad.” The Bee reported that in fact the gas tax was passed by the California legislature, controlled by Harder’s Democrat party. The Stockton Record also called out the lie.**

❌ LIE: Patti voted to make health care more expensive.
✅ TRUTH: The _Sacramento Bee_ also fact checked Harder and pointed out that Supervisor Patti has only approved standard cost of living increases requested by the County’s hospital.* The _Stockton Record_ also called out the lie.**

❌ LIE: Patti is under investigation for bribery.
✅ TRUTH: The investigation is over and found NO MERIT to the bribery allegation as reflected by the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors voted to take no action against Patti (not even a censure).***

❌ LIE: Patti supports a nationwide ban on abortion without exceptions, even in the case of the life of the mother.
✅ TRUTH: The _Stockton Record_ fact checked this and called it out as false.** Patti does strongly oppose, however, Harder’s extreme position that abortion should be legal without restrictions right up until the time of birth.

Patti, on the other hand, has run a positive campaign on the issues:
* INFLATION: He supports reducing the government spending that has caused the problem.
* GAS PRICES: He supports an “all of the above” energy plan to restore America’s energy independence.
* HOMELESS: He supports enforcing no camping laws and providing immediate, temporary shelter and treatment for the homeless.
* DRUG OVERDOSES: He supports a crackdown at the border to stop human and drug trafficking into our country.

| **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

body:
| |
Dear Team,

Last week, during the Florida-Georgia football game in Jacksonville, Florida, a stadium video board was hacked to display the message: “Kanye was right about the Jews.”

Elon Musk’s announcement that he would be bringing “free speech” back to Twitter inspired a coordinated campaign to post thousands of anti-Semitic and racist slurs on the platform.

Meanwhile, a man obsessed with right wing conspiracy theories broke into the home of the Speaker of the House and tried to kill her 82 year old husband. Many politicians in our country responded not by condemning the attack, but by ridiculing the victim.

Racists and political extremists have always existed in America, but on the far out fringes of the political right and left. Until recently, respectable political parties were embarrassed to be associated with them.

When Ronald Reagan was endorsed by white supremacists during his 1984 presidential campaign, he said: ”Those of us in public life can only resent the use of our names by those who seek political recognition for the repugnant doctrines of hate they espouse. The politics of racial hatred and religious bigotry practiced by the Klan and others have no place in this country, and are destructive of the values for which America has always stood.”

Today, I’m not sure if Ronald Reagan could win an election in a Republican primary. The majority of Republicans running in House, Senate, Governor, and Secretary of State races around the country say that the 2020 election was stolen. Some have run campaign videos showing themselves firing weapons at so-called “RINOs” — at moderate members of their own party.

The MAGA Republicans have created a massive echo chamber of lies in which millions of Americans are becoming radicalized. January 6th was one consequence, but there will be more. After all, if people sincerely come to believe that a cabal of illegitimate leaders stole an election and are “destroying” America, some of those people are going to decide that violence is a logical, and morally justified response.

And that brings me to our race in New Jersey’s 7th District.

During our last debate, the moderator asked my opponent Tom Kean Jr. if he agreed with his own father that Donald Trump is not fit to be president of our country. That same day, Trump had put out another one of his blatantly anti-Semitic statements. But Kean Jr. evaded the question. He suggested New Jerseyans were more interested in cheap gas prices than in protecting our country from violence and lies.

My opponent may not be an anti-Semite. But he won’t stand up to anti-Semitism coming from the leader of his party.

He may not approve of a man smashing Nancy Pelosi’s husband’s head with a hammer. But has spent this entire campaign playing to the people who do, attacking her incessantly in campaign ads, while remaining silent on the attempt on her life.

His strategy is to let his Party sow the hate, and then reap the votes.

I think that’s disgraceful. I also think he’s misreading the voters in our District. We may be evenly divided among Democrats, Republicans, and Independents. But most of us want leaders in Washington who will fight inflation AND protect our democracy.

Most of us want more infrastructure bills, and fewer insurrections. We want more problem solvers in Congress, and fewer performance artists. We expect our representatives to compromise for common ground, but be uncompromising in defense of common decency. We would choose moderation over MAGA any day.

Our race will be a bellwether in these midterm elections. It will help decide whether moderation continues to prevail in Congress, or the crazies gain actual power. We have eight days to go. [I hope you’ll do all you can to help us win it.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53755254/376358257/-574637247?amount=10&refcode=TM_EM_FR_3MO_20221031_2_1&refcode2=6d47f410-5659-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDQ3ZjQxMC01NjU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H3JhICSTjWXYZU0ENR2uKTa9-E6T7dtCPHIa3JE3H5w=)

Thanks so much,
Tom

Peter,

On Friday, Kim and her extreme opponent, Matt Larkin, faced off for their first and only debate in the race for Washington's 8th District.

When Matt Larkin was asked to explain his anti-choice positions – supporting a national ban on abortion with no exceptions for "for rape and incest or things like that" – he tried to claim Kim was the one with extreme positions on abortion. **The debate audience laughed at his deflection:** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53723789/376295552/474784691?refcode=em22_221031_debate2_fnd_gq_nopn___ts_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221031_debate2_fnd_gq_nopn___ts_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYmQ2MzMxNi0zNTU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nf4wivbjNG9Y2ONOyZTIqni7NA9PgDJaOqhN3MY6vH8=) While Larkin's claims were ridiculous, there's nothing funny about his extreme views on abortion.

Matt Larkin, on the other hand, has made it clear he stands with MAGA Republicans like Marjorie Taylor Greene, that "this isn't the time for moderation."

Team,
We’re almost there. In less than 24 hours, it will officially be November 1st – with a week left until Election Day.
I know, I’m emailing you on Halloween (I’ll be out later today with Team Slotkin in our milk and cookie costumes - don't worry, we'll send pictures!) So, I’ll keep this short.
Since we won’t be doing our big “end-of-quarter” (or EOQ) push in December after the election, we’re treating today like a mini EOQ, since contributions made in these final stages really do help us out.
There will be quite a bit that pops up in the next 9 days – everything from last minute TV ad buys, to renting event spaces, to hiring additional MSU organizers, to buying more hand warmers for the folks willing to brave outdoor campaign events in a Michigan November with us. Plus, the cost of TV is three times as expensive as it was back in 2020, and staying on the air at the same volume we have been is critical.
While this is one of the most competitive House races in the country and THE most competitive House race in Michigan, I’ve run in tough races before. We have a path to victory here, but it relies on having the resources to make it happen – hence our end of month push before we head into November.
If you want to help us keep this seat, chip in below before midnight, tonight. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221031&amount=28] Thanks for bearing with me – now, go enjoy Halloween!

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53724294/376296808/333259033?refcode=em_221031_closerad&sourceid=1030989&refcode2=f0d63316-3559-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGQ2MzMxNi0zNTU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dGkZ6uPsLq26MFBOHgGjWHOsR1WpaaFn6FB2WBwHubA=)

subject: It has to be us.

Friend, Time is running very short before Election Day. So I want to make sure my words are as clear as possible. Our country – our democracy – has never faced a threat like the one we’re facing now. And if we’re going to overcome it, it’s going to take _every single one of us_. It’s not enough to assume someone else will deal with the attacks on our very system of government. It has to be us – you and me. There are so many things you can do. You can volunteer at the polls. You can take your neighbors to vote. You can talk about the election with your family. And you can – and I hope you will [**_make a donation to the NDRC._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53726352/376303376/693620013?amount=30&refcode=20221031.3r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM3NmIxNTA3LTM3NTktZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4MPDxgKpWaj8Jzwvk1kgz_72q-PsWnQI_RIdE5VR8Bk=) | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53726353/376303377/693620013?amount=30&refcode=20221031.3r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM3NmIxNTA3LTM3NTktZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4MPDxgKpWaj8Jzwvk1kgz_72q-PsWnQI_RIdE5VR8Bk=)
---
I believe in this country, friend. I believe in our democracy. I believe the American people will vote in eight days like our democracy is at stake. But it’s our job to help them get there.
For months now, that’s exactly what the team at the NDRC has been doing. We’ve been diligently identifying and supporting nearly 500 candidates, from those running for governor to those running for state legislature, who voters can rely on to defend democracy from vicious attacks.
We’ve been partnering with groups like The States Project to invest in flipping state legislative chambers so that our movement can stop MAGA Republicans from hijacking election results, as Donald Trump tried to do in 2020.
We’ve been working in key states to protect and even expand the right to vote. And with our affiliates, we’ve been defending election infrastructure by recruiting poll workers.
But _it won’t be enough without you, friend_. If there was ever a moment to get off the sidelines and take action, it’s this one.
So I’m asking one more time. [**_Tonight is the most important deadline of this entire election. Can you dig deep and give to the NDRC today?_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53726354/376303378/693620013?amount=30&refcode=20221031.3r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM3NmIxNTA3LTM3NTktZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4MPDxgKpWaj8Jzwvk1kgz_72q-PsWnQI_RIdE5VR8Bk=)

clean_body: | Friend, Time is running very short before Election Day. So I want to make sure my words are as clear as possible. Our country – our democracy – has never faced a threat like the one we’re facing now. And if we’re going to overcome it, it’s going to take every single one of us. It’s not enough to assume someone else will deal with the attacks on our very system of government. It has to be us – you and me. There are so many things you can do. You can volunteer at the polls. I believe the American people will vote in eight days like our democracy is at stake. But it’s our job to help them get there. For months now, that’s exactly what the team at the NDRC has been doing. We’ve been diligently identifying and supporting nearly 500 candidates, from those running for governor to those running for state legislature, who voters can rely on to defend democracy from vicious attacks. body:
Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $370.
The only thing I’m guilty of is making my opponent and national Democrats spend money to defend a congressional seat they think belongs to them | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z774skdf45969lunkm997bp2667ha1qffp7dgupg_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9gmepj4cph2bs)

Fellow Conservative,

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I’m being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

**Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $370.** If you read the note yesterday morning, then you may recall that needed that email to raise $10,038– more than**_27 times what we wound up raising by the day’s end._**

I don’t want to sound like an alarmist, but yesterday’s fundraising totals shocked me to the core. We’re 11 days out from Election Day and must meet very real fundraising goals to keep our campaign fully funded through November 8th.**If we have another day like yesterday today, tomorrow, or any day left remaining in this campaign, then flipping this seat is probably not going to happen.**

**[Are you able to kick-in $5, $10 or $15 right now to help us make up yesterday’s missed fundraising goal?](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfsa4ves28nco3vlmhc9464qkes2ltuovq3i1u10_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9gmepj4cph2bs)**

| | | | | | | | | [](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=fcfdd54fb9&e=fdefed58de)
---
| Friend,
Pittsburgh’s local NPR station broke the story about how **Josh Shapiro’s campaign is almost entirely funded by deep-pocketed, out-of-state Leftist activists:**
“Shapiro’s expenses suggest a targeted effort to court out-of-state donors. His campaign finance reports list $240,000 in airfare — including private flights... as well as hotel stays in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Washington, D.C., and Miami, among other locales...

The Shapiro campaign declined to answer specific questions about his out-of-state fundraising.” | | | | [SUPPORT MY FIGHT!](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=a4d9cbe3c9&e=fdefed58de)
---
Meanwhile, here’s what they said about **me and where _my_ supporters come from:**

“Mastriano’s fundraising base tightly clusters around his home base in Franklin County...

Mastriano’s campaign boasts **higher percentages of in-state donors and money**...

More than **seven in eight of his donors live in Pennsylvania.”**

My campaign is **fueled by the people of Pennsylvania**...because I’m fighting FOR the people of Pennsylvania.

Shapiro’s is fueled by **Leftist billionaires who think they can buy a “flyover state” like ours**...destroy our economy, rip apart our energy sector, and manipulate our election in 2024.

It’s up to YOU and ME to stop them, but **[I need your help](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=3068e3b137&e=fdefed58de)**.

body:
How WE can help Wisconsin| | | [](http://links.votemichelsforgov.com/u/click?_t=41b24d3b5b56407d9b83bd257723f463&_m=7c172c25690f4e81b939c3c43f1799b3&_e=LWKhlTshbSG9amJNGVxP650LwP73QaWqvUkxU-Th6ye1JcQ3QgTf-z1r1i6kD9QYL223pKQ6Y1-IbQWYWJxP1lhP-0i621u9VkzrDJ7gFiNb8KfB1daAUHwGIqsRGUVzWBfqQYP5CYmw1LpB7frpE22-i3bcXh727KKqQ2phMhI3pkvhltoUCiCH2dJc1lEcn4eJGAY_nJFBNmfyQqS09UbiVqTRY-UF-fruLUC-eTCDhSH5GdJ0LLaWUVKrwJcT1w852TpeeGsp5u8Y9IxNUNTQV6-Q_yOsnUzj_SjbATFWmzWWDKRntSctWCoLbBvOLqqDgZKgu6ho1ryYVPP_oCIZEk3n8m1Sy4qrUwkGMfZywxBrR5uKVdbpliIZFtqGcWR1m2bIb2MNuIhkrdgksXDaxsyrYD9RRwfqErFSSplyip_I49vRrr66nEqEGNkP)
---
Peter, Let’s rewind a couple of years to the Summer of 2020.
In Blue states like Wisconsin, Democratic Governors like Tony Evers were busy locking
people down and shutting down businesses, all while letting rioters burn their cities. **But not Florida.** We drew a line in the sand and stood up for freedom. Their freedom to make a living,
send kids to school, see loved ones, and live in freedom.
And because of that, **Florida became the beacon of freedom for the rest of the
country**— _even ‘Lockdown Liberals’ came to Florida to enjoy our freedom._
While ‘the free state of Florida’ is unique, the rights we cherish and protect aren’t.
They are spelled out clearly in the Constitution for every American.

**All it takes is a leader willing to defend it. And that’s exactly what Tim Michels will
do as Governor of Wisconsin.**
---
[**JOIN RON DESANTIS AND TIM MICHELS: RUSH IN NOW**](http://links.votemichelsforgov.com/u/click?_t=41b24d3b5b56407d9b83bd257723f463&_m=7c172c25690f4e81b939c3c43f1799b3&_e=LWKhlTshbSG9amJNGVxP650LwP73QaWqvUkxU-Th6ye1JcQ3QgTf-z1r1i6kD9QYL223pKQ6Y1-IbQWYWJxP1lhP-0i621u9VkzrDJ7gFiNb8KfB1daAUHwGIqsRGUVzWBfqQYP5CYmw1LpB7frpE22-i3bcXh727KKqQ2phMhI3pkvhltoUCiCH2dJc1lEcn4eJGAY_nJFBNmfyQqS09UbiVqTRY-UF-fruLUC-eTCDhSH5GdJ0LLaWUVKrwJcT1w852TpeeGsp5u8Y9IxNUNTQV6-Q_yOsnUzj_SjbATHcYwrWP5Xs7fVKo6B2RZvEDiPmfapvCMFnaPuVOfLcdjX1a8VLoDoBeDwQWzrUwYjfBWnCYLOkLVTinl5Wrq7rIW1Nk_pqh3TXGpGhDmO9AxNLNnAGYd2RnHWCxKf9lFLHyZMNJBAmqxOUXXkOOprh)
---
Tim Michels will be your last line of defense against Joe Biden and an out-of-control
federal government.
Like me, Tim served his country, and swore an oath to defend the Constitution and our
liberties. An oath he kept in his 12 years of service in the US Army...and one I know he

Friend,

I am just a kid from Wrightsville, Georgia, who has lived the American Dream.

Growing up, I had a speech impediment. I was embarrassed to speak up in class or to ask my teachers for help, so my grades suffered in elementary school. I lived in fear of what my classmates might do or say to me on the playground.

My parents were extremely hardworking people, but they didn't have a lot of money. They couldn't afford to send me to a private school or hire a specialist to help me improve my speech. All roads in my small town of Wrightsville seemed to indicate that I would struggle for the rest of my time in school. Luckily for me, that was not the end of my story.

_**[Will you help me win back our Republican majority?>>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsi4ujt504euei0e0bp8i7qijuej1smjlab8erl8_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9gm6ob2c1h2bs)**_

I began sitting in front of the mirror every day and reciting difficult words again and again until I got them right. Eventually, my speech began to improve, and I gained the confidence to speak up in class. I also started working out and made both the track and football teams.

After helping my high school football team win a state championship, I continued playing football at the University of Georgia. I helped the Bulldogs win the 1980 national championship, and I capped my college career by winning the 1982 Heisman Trophy. I played 15 years in the USFL and NFL for several incredible teams. I then had the honor of representing the United States in the 1992 Winter Olympics in bobsledding.

_**I am proof the American Dream is alive and well.**_

_**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save the American Dream.>>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf79d3r6lnhfdgss1uofg4f9gh5mieffn47ith4o_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9gm6ob2c1h2bs)**_

Only in the United States, the greatest country in the WORLD, is my story possible. America is a nation built on self-determination, and no matter a person's beginnings, we all have the opportunity to reach the top of our chosen field.

Together, we can take back our Republican majority and save the American Dream for every American, no matter who you are or where you come from. But we need YOU on our team. Will you join me in this fight to preserve the greatest country in the world?

name: Full Mag News
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=15e033187549467581628ba9f389d4e7&_e=vtCIkzVCNdJbTnE-MQ7wWhUvkU3qmVky1Y4GgOWpR1QuXfvMUrW50Djk_0S0gYblCAsrfxGaU7ygftqyAgqoPt4mBN_-T4MQpBXBV1OqERmyeqsXN8zmp3H9KVHd0xrzVjnnc09pXV3yPW_Pitu8dKVVABGdBLvUotqXgqQGN3iGIyBcXlgN1Q9RTKIFfHOFpNIpuF6FPUKtVZv407MAWHpO2NT5Zcp4A9hweg9CWwKSck1A73-r_rFBu7E3SmyoN8ZKfEnuECc1jFQNp1_6j-b7xGoAtXNxKCNkcYIUnH-LnN84DNr7N-68cUMXjcDp7i-Br0Yo-R1aga9iGrkknTu4wsBlWEg79CVpTRDMf7qPJhJGXelu64RNtnLlocoodwtkevd_7wQc38xlbTdTfg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=15e033187549467581628ba9f389d4e7&_e=vtCIkzVCNdJbTnE-MQ7wWhUvkU3qmVky1Y4GgOWpR1QuXfvMUrW50Djk_0S0gYblCAsrfxGaU7ygftqyAgqoPt4mBN_-T4MQpBXBV1OqERmyeqsXN8zmp3H9KVHd0xrzVjnnc09pXV3yPW_Pitu8dKVVABGdBLvUotqXgqQGN3iGIyBcXlgN1Q9RTKIFfHOFpNIpuF6FPUKtVZv407MAWHpO2NT5Zcp4A9hweg9CWwKtPD39di_QHWKOwMCv8u2qC49_tkrVbgiZFCeJC6oF-wJD6y8Fw_qBcWWHKdUMezNK86ZJ-z0h8kjM2MSDr1FWkPXl1VFsimRgAgFZkXgXHEBsLeb6oP4OljnzDgLcotlhSWe_bCV5_SrcuX-lHIq0eIovoC-l-IYkB1OQJKsB6g%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=15e033187549467581628ba9f389d4e7&_e=vtCIkzVCNdJbTnE-MQ7wWhUvkU3qmVky1Y4GgOWpR1QuXfvMUrW50Djk_0S0gYblCAsrfxGaU7ygftqyAgqoPt4mBN_-T4MQpBXBV1OqERmyeqsXN8zmp3H9KVHd0xrzVjnnc09pXV3yPW_Pitu8dKVVABGdBLvUotqXgqQGN3iGIyBcXlgN1Q9RTKIFfHOFpNIpuF6FPUKtVZv407MAWHpO2NT5Zcp4A9hweg9CWwIu3dF9L2nK9IJuyG_a50uO8uTvJ9BYbW3C2cCgXmTLTFOMxgY8exvxSmcp6g00DbrZ4f1jr7d6PUt8oYLX6swDhfGZ4aZgMeyjoex4TdKS6q2NNrCQM_XCkdUkPHACZt5fXGtXTAdYhKBA4HOZeWxLO60oPbC249LeN2n6fFF_DA%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Peter,I wanted to start this one off by immediately recognizing you and thanking you for your support. Were it not for you, this campaign wouldn't be where it is today. Were it not for you, this campaign wouldn't exist.Your efforts, contributions, and support have allowed me to have the resources to spread the word of this campaign and raise awareness on things like parental rights, smaller government, and the need for REAL unity.From teams knocking on doors, making calls, polling, media appearances, to even having the resources to send **THIS** email -- its all because of YOU and I am eternally grateful.**Thank you.** New Jersey’s 12th District is ready for a change and our nearly two-year campaign has proven that. Now that we are seeing the early votes come in and the last minute polling, we’re understanding that this race is closer than we even thought. Years of the poor Democrat representation have taken their toll on this community and now the people are ready for a change.As gas spikes to record levels and crime is out of control, the years-long “vote blue no matter who” mentality has been broken — and I’m confident that in ten days we will win. But, that victory is going to require your help.
| [LET’S GET THIS CAMPAIGN TO VICTORY!](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=18d8fa63d7&e=fdefed58de)
---
We're less than two weeks away from election day, and I look forward to it. I believe our collective efforts will not go unnoticed, and we will make a difference. Sure, there's a bit of nerves, but overall I feel like we're all approaching November 8th with positivity.That's all for this one, just a quick check-in that I saw as an opportunity to extend my gratitude to you. As always, if you're able to help us out at the link below a little bit goes a LONG way, and we can use EVERYTHING we can in these final days.Here is a link to donate directly to the campaign and help us flip this swing district. Winning the House back runs through districts like mine: [https://secure.winred.com/darius-mayfield-for-america/avcpros](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=d5a5b71959&e=fdefed58de)But most importantly I just wanted to let you know that I couldn't be more appreciative of you than I already am.New Jersey's 12th District is not a "progressive" district, yet our representative is a member of the Progressive Caucus right along with Maxine Waters, Ilhan Omar and AOC. She hugs the Left flank of the party tightly and votes along with it almost every single time. She's voted for gun control, said nothing as Biden destroyed our economy and has forgotten all about the communities in her district that desperately need her help.My district is crying out for help. We need school choice. We need our economy able to thrive again. We need JOBS! We don't need more division coming out of CongressThis is a dire crossroads in our nation's history, and what we do right now will have direct consequences for generations of Americans.**Can I count on you today to help us with a grassroots donation so that I can continue voter outreach and reach every single voter in this district in the next ten days?**

This November 8th, we need to elect a governor who will lower the cost of living, combat climate change, create housing and strengthen our economy. ** That’s why I’m supporting Brenda Siegel for Governor. I know she’ll fight for every Vermonter in every corner of the state. I’ve run plenty of races in Vermont myself. I know firsthand that no election is easy. In order for Brenda to win, she needs the resources to do it. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: Brenda has been an effective advocate in Vermont for years. Supporters, _The Bad News:_ The Associated Press just reported how the disgraced Trump-enabler Michael Flynn is targeting school board elections to spread his "Christian nationalism." Flynn is just the latest unhinged, dangerous right-winger to target school board elections and try to take over our schools. _The Good News:_ We are fighting back, supporting educators running for School Board. And when we help, our educators tend to win: 84% of EEE's School Board candidates have won in the last year. It's not hopeless. >From Arizona to Michigan to Virginia, teachers, guidance counselors, and school librarians are locked in tight races to determine the future of our schools. We're right there with them, educating voters every day. _The Choice:_ We can sit back and hope good candidates win this year, and gamble that voters see through the lies and the disinformation. Or, we can reach voters right now, when they are making up their minds, with exactly the information they need to cast an informed ballot. **When you donate, you help these educators reach more voters and tell their stories. * There's Betsy DeVos and other millionaires who want to steal money from public schools for their selfish, private aims
* Politicians like Ron DeSantis and Glenn Youngkin are happy to hurt our kids if it helps them run for President
* We're fighting racists who want to whitewash history and ban books
* And we've got far-right bullies who are attacking LGBTQ+ students, targeting transgender kids for abuse and ridicule.

In the face of all of that, retired and active teachers are running on their own to protect their schools and our kids. They are knocking on doors, talking with voters, and answering voters' questions (usually with way too much detail and thought!).
Now it's our chance to give them one more boost here at the end.

Friend,

I am just a kid from Wrightsville, Georgia, who has lived the American Dream.

Growing up, I had a speech impediment. I was embarrassed to speak up in class or to ask my teachers for help, so my grades suffered in elementary school. I lived in fear of what my classmates might do or say to me on the playground.

My parents were extremely hardworking people, but they didn't have a lot of money. They couldn't afford to send me to a private school or hire a specialist to help me improve my speech. All roads in my small town of Wrightsville seemed to indicate that I would struggle for the rest of my time in school. Luckily for me, that was not the end of my story.

_**[Will you help me win back our Republican majority?>>](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5kaajf2vmd7uoqmhav7hfcj4uu1gcqgd3ehk1o0_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9im8pb3c5h2bs)**_

I began sitting in front of the mirror every day and reciting difficult words again and again until I got them right. Eventually, my speech began to improve, and I gained the confidence to speak up in class. I also started working out and made both the track and football teams.

After helping my high school football team win a state championship, I continued playing football at the University of Georgia. I helped the Bulldogs win the 1980 national championship, and I capped my college career by winning the 1982 Heisman Trophy. I played 15 years in the USFL and NFL for several incredible teams. I then had the honor of representing the United States in the 1992 Winter Olympics in bobsledding.

_**I am proof the American Dream is alive and well.**_

_**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save the American Dream.>>](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zra587elri62m821dsv24ntjogif4u8t5fmjjou0_rp22sh2s8i66or7c9im8pb3c5h2bs)**_

Only in the United States, the greatest country in the WORLD, is my story possible. America is a nation built on self-determination, and no matter a person's beginnings, we all have the opportunity to reach the top of our chosen field.

Together, we can take back our Republican majority and save the American Dream for every American, no matter who you are or where you come from. But we need YOU on our team. Will you join me in this fight to preserve the greatest country in the world?

Folks,

Tomorrow night is my Fox News Town Hall with JD Vance, and what would
really make me confident heading into the final week of this race would be
hitting our big $2 million End-of-Month goal.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/29910?t=1010&amount=32&akid=6348%2E3611125%2EYP1UYs ]Can I count on you to rush a $32 matched donation right now? With
Trump’s super PAC unexpectedly dumping $1.3 million into this race, we
need to ramp up our fundraising ASAP before tonight's deadline.

Look, I won't win over every single voter tomorrow night—and that’s ok.

If you want a nationwide abortion ban with no exceptions that puts the
health of millions of women at risk, I’m probably not your candidate.

If you refuse to admit that Joe Biden won the 2020 election, I’m probably
not your candidate.

And if you don’t think it’s worth trying to bring good-paying union jobs
back to Ohio, then you might as well vote for JD Vance.

But if you believe in protecting our personal freedoms, a functioning
democracy, and fighting for Ohio workers, then I’m the only guy for the
job.

The bottom line is that JD Vance is just too extreme for Ohio. And while
I’m feeling pretty confident that voters will see through his phony
“moderate” act during tomorrow night's town hall, this race is too close
for comfort—we can’t leave anything up to chance.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/29910?t=1012&amount=32&akid=6348%2E3611125%2EYP1UYs ]Can I count on you to chip in a matched donation of $32 or any amount

ad buys? Knowing our fundraising is squared away before tonight's midnight

Happy Halloween, Peter! It's Christina, Trudy's daughter. As a mother myself, my Halloweens these days are all about my kids: picking out costumes, carving pumpkins, and, of course, trick-or-treating.
**But today, I wanted to share a memory from one of my first Halloweens.** (I promise this is related to my mom's campaign, just bear with me for a moment!)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53766171/376389182/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk376-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGMzNTMxMy02ODU5LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3D9UHUQqqG68H3Fo2faB5y5vLCrzJgFdLxqyPo3Wr8U=)

And even from a young age, I recognized that's what a real-life hero looks like.**
That's why I know that my mom is going to be such an honest, effective, and compassionate senator. **Washington needs a nurse's heart and a nurse's mind. But more than anything else, Washington needs my mom.** She'll put people before politics every single time.

I can’t tell you how grateful I am for your support over the past 10 months
Peter,
Ten months ago, we embarked on this journey together, launching what many thought to be a “long-shot” campaign for Congress.
As a mom, a teacher, and a local representative for Windham County, most Vermonters did not know who I was a year ago. But little by little, we built a campaign based on a progressive vision of what we can achieve – Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, affordable housing and living wages for Vermont workers – and thousands of folks joined us to build one of the most robust, people-powered campaigns Vermont has ever seen.
As we approach our final end-of-month deadline before Election Day, I want you to know that I’ve never taken your support for granted, and I’m honored to have you with me in this fight. Your contributions allowed us to win a competitive primary in August — and will put us on the path to victory once again in November.
No one left behind, no one forgotten – that will be my mission when I become the first congresswoman from Vermont on November 8th. Are you with me?

Dear friends and supporters, This morning I attended a Press Conference at the broken " Congress Street Bridge". My opponent reminded us that 14 years ago he became responsible for this project and announced the State of Connecticut had finally issued permits for work to begin. As a former local official for my own town, I found it upsetting and frustrating that the local Bridgeport officials had to advocate, push, work and wait for more than a decade for my opponent to make progress on his promise. Himes’ broken promises have real world impacts on people. It was painful to see the senior public housing high rise across the waterway surrounded by blight without access to downtown operations and merchants. Local officials and first responders have been left to try their best to provide quality of life and emergency services to their constituents, as residents were cut off from the downtown and their neighborhoods were forgotten. I hope for the people of Bridgeport that this announcement becomes a reality. IT’S TIME! IT’S TIME for a champion to recognize the impacts on people. IT’S TIME for a champion who follows through on promises. IT’S TIME for a champion who shephards projects to progress. IT’S TIME for a champion for Connecticut. Yes, IT'S TIME to expect more and elect Jayme Stevenson as our next Congresswoman. Volunteers needed: plant lawn signs, door knock, phone bank, work at the polls. My name is Stacey Yvonne Abrams and I’m running to be the next governor of the great state of Georgia. | The journey to this moment has been a long one, Derek.

**But before I tell you more, I need your help in the final stretch of this race.**

[Election Day is in less than 8 days and my team can’t fall short between now and November 8. Will you split $10 right now between Tony Evers and me to help fuel our campaigns? Every vote counts in this election — and so does every contribution.](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1894?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_abrams_3MU_20221031_1_1&t=5&akid=5862%2E1827488%2EHzosVK)

| ****[DONATE](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1894?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_abrams_3MU_20221031_1_1&t=6&akid=5862%2E1827488%2EHzosVK)****
---

Derek, I began this journey in June 2017, when I stood in Chehaw Park in Albany to announce my candidacy for governor. I ran for 16 months. By the end of the campaign, our team had mobilized the most diverse coalition Georgia had ever seen before.

**Even as the odds mounted against us, and Republicans worked hard to decrease access to voting, we fought to the very end. With hope. With determination.**

But I didn’t get the job in 2018.

But I didn’t quit, I kept working for Georgians. I changed my _how_ but never lost what drives me. And I decided to try again because I know Georgia can be extraordinary if we truly invest in our people. I believe in meeting people where they are, not where you want them to be. I believe that if we want people to turn out, we have to show that it is worth the pain of hope.

**But it’s not about 2018, 2020 or 2021 anymore. This year, we face a once-in-a-generation opportunity to make unprecedented progress both today and tomorrow for our families. We look to the future and imagine the incredible story we can write for ourselves and our families — if we have a governor who sees all of us.**

[That’s why I know it’s worth it to fight. To try again. To do everything we can to win. So, that’s why I ask, Derek. Will you do everything you can to help us get voters to the polls in the last week and win? Splitting $25 — or even $10 — between my campaign and Tony's campaign will make a lasting difference in this final stretch. ](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1894?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_abrams_3MU_20221031_1_1&t=7&akid=5862%2E1827488%2EHzosVK)

****[DONATE](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1894?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_abrams_3MU_20221031_1_1&t=8&akid=5862%2E1827488%2EHzosVK)****
---

This time, let’s get it done.

— Stacey

subject: This is my story

body:
| |
---
| | | Peter, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61771666:JfsJCsGNa:m:1:3368395361:C6DCD5AE367968BA72D10B8384E46BAC:r "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61771666:JfsJCsGNa:m:1:3368395361:C6DCD5AE367968BA72D10B8384E46BAC:r "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61771666:JfsJCsGNa:m:1:3368395361:C6DCD5AE367968BA72D10B8384E46BAC:r "Adam 2")
---

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61771666:JfsJCsGNa:m:1:3368395361:C6DCD5AE367968BA72D10B8384E46BAC:r "Adam 3")

My race is **officially the #1 race in the country** , and all eyes are on me. The Democrats have already raised 76 MILLION to destroy my campaign.

Unlike my opponent, I rely on grassroots supporters like you to keep my campaign running.

I know I will be great leader for the people of Nevada, and for the people of America.

Now that you know my story, _**[will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61771666:JfsJCsGNa:m:1:3368395361:C6DCD5AE367968BA72D10B8384E46BAC:r "will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?")**_

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt
_Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Nevada_

body:
| | | I wanted to send you a quick personal note as we close out today’s critical end-of-month fundraising on why this race is so important to me. | | Team,

I wanted to send you a quick personal note as we close out today’s critical end-of-month fundraising on why this race is so important to me.

Houston is the city I was born and raised in, and the spirit of our great city runs strong within me. Our people are hardworking and innovative, and our city is bursting at the seams with untapped potential. But we are missing a crucial connection, team.

body:
I know Mark pretty well, better than most.
#

Friends — it’s Scott Kelly, Mark’s twin brother and fellow astronaut!
I know Mark pretty well, better than most.
He’s a real leader and exactly the type of person that Arizona and our country need in the Senate right now. He’s bringing people together at a time of increasing division, and is standing up to corporate special interest groups on behalf of Arizonans — no matter how hard they’ll campaign against him.
The truth is, not everybody likes that. And that’s exactly why people like Donald Trump, Mitch McConnell, and far-right billionaires are working so hard to beat him.
It’s never easy watching your older brother (by six minutes) get attacked in TV ads and by the former president, but I’m grateful to know people like you have his back.
You don’t hear from me too often, so when I reach out I hope you know it’s important. And today’s request couldn’t be more important:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to my brother Mark Kelly’s re-election campaign? With the end of October here, what we do now is more important than ever. These are truly the [**_final_**](http://links.kathysalvi.com/u/click?_t=7db65ff0bd284bf489cf7cd8aa1d7d87&_m=4d890a6939ab4b2a92ebf65c22f8dca1&_e=f8GEh8860rs3VVLtuWuZRQjhOjly_hfnXh6Ypytteyeio-GvjKYHI0IJPQEUquhoDFFlf3ysKWmvomMgpiolWlKO9CpSwSoDw_oJr77fTlqAm9s6srK44iU5w0kMOogBXeNA4C9oEgNCakRtQZcTl4LK9IC5tUlZmQmmeGfCM_-kRMnL4Ur2xHgacZoKC0VpWbqVjr8_DF4b0HxaEEfKsDsONCVNmZjmCXLP3CyhqRDuFceHtDdy6LA8iz3_cjACJPskHZLhehXuCYaouUvND1vFtr3d4n91uMCKc42CU72R-sIuNAbX1-Q0GvDxIhOflpa15-vtZt63TthG1iXYFGgIYY6T8jfQycRuHJeNhwSAz6Nbi6H7THjz__eP4vrz6jhXT1BRt9Aetr-adWqxcu4RICLGyt83Nu8UIo3Q8eg%3D) days I have to prove that a better future for Illinois is possible.

body:
Every non-voting Republican needs to get this message

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

People like me don’t usually run for office. I grew up in rural Colorado, sometimes on food stamps, sometimes going to food banks. That’s why it’s such an honor to be able to work to ensure that all Coloradans have voting access, no matter their zip code or the amount of money in their bank account. But this race is getting closer, and to win, I need supporters like you to step up. Please help me win this race by rushing in a donation of any size right now.
